### Analyst, Investments
Investments - London, London, City of (Hybrid)
---
About 17Capital
17Capital is a private credit manager, specializing in NAV finance for the private equity industry. It provides non-dilutive capital to high-quality private equity management companies, funds, and institutional investors as part of their toolkit for value creation and portfolio management.
Founded in 2008, 17Capital has completed over 130 investments, deploying more than $20 billion alongside leading private equity franchises globally.
For more information, please go to www.17capital.com
Overview
The Investment team, a single team across both preferred equity and credit strategies, is responsible for the origination and execution of investments and consists of more than 30 professionals across New York and London.
Under the supervision of mid-level investment professionals, the Investment Analyst will take a role in sourcing, analysis, execution and monitoring of both preferred equity and credit investments, working on both US and European transactions as required.
Role & Responsibilities
Screen & analyse investment opportunities:
* Review preliminary information and conduct due diligence on underlying portfolio (by fund and/or company)
* Analysis of underlying portfolio managers, strategy, track record and investor base
* Build companies’ performance projections and cash flow models
* Assist in structuring and pricing of transactions and return underwriting
* Write summary investment memos and help the team to present to investment committee
* Assist in transaction execution and legal process
Monitoring existing portfolio:
* Review information received on existing investments
* Coordinate with investee managers when required
* Write investment reviews for quarterly reporting
Deal origination & marketing:
* Support the preparation of deal sourcing, fundraising, and investor update materials
* Screen, identify, and build relationships with appropriate deal flow targets
* Track and analyse performance of origination and marketing strategies
* Prepare materials for and participate in deal origination meetings
Other:
* Support the company’s values and culture
* Participate in strategic sessions and company offsites
* International travel as required for deal origination, monitoring and execution purposes
*This job description is subject to the terms and conditions of an employee’s Employment Contract and associated policies. The employee shall perform such duties that are not written here as the Company may reasonably require.*
Skillset required
* One (1) to three (3) years of experience in investment banking, leveraged finance, private credit, private equity secondaries, and/or equivalent experience
* Excellent academic credentials
* Outstanding analytical skills and attention to detail
* Good financial knowledge and basic aptitude in financial modelling
* A critical thinker with an active interest in alternative investment space
* A team player who is able to work in a collaborative, fast paced environment
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with willingness to present to small groups
* Fluency/professional proficiency in English with other languages as a plus
* Able to demonstrate honesty, integrity, and professionalism
We offer you:
* Career development, including comprehensive in-house training programme
* Opportunity to learn and grow whilst making a meaningful contribution to the continued expansion of 17Capital during an exciting time of the firm’s overall growth phase
* Opportunity to work on innovative and high-profile transactions with leading global financial sponsors
* Competitive reward and benefits
17Capital's values
Our values are the basis on which we build strong relationships with our clients, our investors and each other. They are the foundation of our business and integral to our continued ability to pioneer success.
Build trust – We behave and act in ways that earn trust
Embrace “different” – We embrace new ideas and constantly strive to discover new ways of doing things
Make things happen – We are agile and responsive in a way that delivers success for all our stakeholders
Strive for excellence – We act with professionalism and adhere to our high standards

# 2K Games -Publishing Graduate Program - London
London, England, United Kingdom
Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, and HB Studios. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building, and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.
Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, problem solvers, and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of our growing library of critically acclaimed franchises such as NBA 2K, Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, PGA TOUR 2K, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization, WWE 2K, and XCOM.
At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We are dedicated to diversity and inclusion and want our community of candidates to reflect this commitment. We encourage all qualified applicants to explore our global positions.
### Publishing Graduate Program
Our graduate program is a rotation-based journey through our business, based in Dublin, London or Novato, with the possibility of a rotation in one of our international offices. You'll help shape your own experience as we match your learning goals to our business needs.
### What is the Publishing Graduate Program?
When people hear ‘publishing,’ they usually think “books”. At 2K, it means everything that happens outside of game development to bring games to market and get them in front of players: advertising, budget planning, marketing technology, live services, growth strategy, player insights and analytics, and go-to-market planning. Our rotations give you hands-on experience across the whole publishing organisation.
### Before You Apply...
### Who are we looking for?
We hire less for a specific degree and more for how you think and work. Across the business, the graduates who thrive tend to be curious, take ownership of their work and think critically about what they're being asked to do, as well as take feedback well. Beyond that, our graduates join us from science, economics, engineering, philosophy, social sciences, arts, and everywhere in between. Our recruitment process is task-based, so you get a real chance to show what you can do. Once you're in, our foundation training and ongoing development mean you're never figuring it out alone.
We consider a “recent graduate” to be anyone who has graduated within two years of the program (January 2025 - June 2027) start date in July 2027.
### Do I have to be a gamer?
Not at all. Some of our graduates have never played a game, while others play every day, and both bring perspectives that we value. Whether you're an avid gamer or picking up a controller for the first time, you'll have a point of view to bring to any team you join.
### How do we recruit?
We keep our process short and straightforward, because we know applying for jobs is stressful enough. We hire for analytical thinking, tested across three areas: quantitative skills, qualitative skills, and how quickly you pick up something new. Combined with your interview, that's how we get a sense of the curiosity, drive and critical thinking we're looking for. If that sounds like you, we'd love to receive your application.
### What Will I Be Doing?
The program starts with training to set you up with foundational skills. After that, you'll take on a maximum of six three-month rotations across our publishing teams, from marketing and brand to product and player science. By the end of the program, you'll walk away with three core skill sets: analytical, technical, and commercial. We don't expect people to arrive with all three, and that's the point. We're looking for people with the potential to grow, and we'll help you get there.
You can explore each rotation in detail on our graduate program page.
### What Happens After the Program?
By the end of the program, you'll be ready to specialize and apply for permanent roles across the business, whether that's digital marketing, marketing technology, or analytics. You'll have built a well-rounded skill set, from advanced Excel to our own approach to project management, and be well prepared to take on a role and thrive in it. At the core of this program is a commitment to growing our own future leaders, and we're fully invested in giving you the training and path to get there.

# 2K Games - Technical Art Graduate Program - Dublin
Dublin, Ireland
Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, and HB Studios. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building, and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.
Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, problem solvers, and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of our growing library of critically acclaimed franchises such as NBA 2K, Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, PGA TOUR 2K, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization, WWE 2K, and XCOM.
At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We are dedicated to diversity and inclusion and want our community of candidates to reflect this commitment. We encourage all qualified applicants to explore our global positions.
### What is Technical Art?
Technical Artists make the art team more capable than it would be on its own. The art team is your customer, its problems set your priorities, and your work is judged on whether the artists it was built for actually use it.
In practice that means building the tools artists use to create content, the rigs that make characters move, the shaders that give a world its look, the rules that scatter a landscape with vegetation, and the pipelines that carry all of it into the game.
### Program overview
21 months, starting Summer 2027, based in Dublin.
**Foundation Training. Eleven weeks.**
You get a brief, a deadline, and the tools art teams use every day, and you work out how to deliver. You build across all four specializations, including the ones you are weakest in: Pipeline and Tools, Character and Animation, Rendering and Visuals, Environment and World. What you build is reviewed by people who do this for a living, and the review covers how you worked and how you talked to the people you built it for, not only what you delivered. Some of the work is yours alone and some is shared with the Engineering and Publishing graduates.
Foundation Training runs on Unreal Engine, Maya, Python, and Perforce. The program assumes you arrive knowing one or two of them, not all four.
**Three strategic rotations, six months each.**
Rotations run across our studios, including Hangar 13, HB Studios, Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Small Axe, and Gearbox, and across the central technology teams that build the tools and pipelines every studio shares. Which team you rotate onto is decided around game timelines, and what the teams need at the time, and your own developing focus is part of that conversation.
### What we are looking for
An outstanding portfolio is the first thing we look at, and it should show the work and how you got there. It does not have to be an art portfolio. Tools, scripts, rigs, shaders all count. If the work was made with other people, tell us which parts were yours.
There are two things you need:
* Comfort in at least one content-creation package or game engine. Maya, Blender, Houdini, Substance, Unreal Engine, or whatever you happened to learn.
* Some scripting. It does not need to be much, but you should be able to read code and have written something.
Beyond that, the qualities that matter most:
* **Curiosity.** You want to know how things are made, and you dig in to find out.
* **Persistence.** A lot of this job is being stuck: something is broken, the reason is not obvious, and you keep going until you find it.
* **Communication.** You will spend more time talking and asking questions than most people expect.
**Education.** Game Art, Animation, VFX, Technical Art, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. We also take people with any unrelated degree who have a portfolio that shows the work. What you have made matters more to us than where you studied. The key is that you have a recent degree.
**Experience.** No games industry experience is needed. This is a graduate program, and it is built for people who have never worked in games. Mod work, game jams, university projects, and freelance work are all relevant experiences as far as we are concerned.
**Recent graduates.** Eligible Grads from January 2025 to June 2027 are eligible to apply. Exceptions may be made on a case-by-case basis if your grad date falls outside of these dates.
Technical Art is a job people arrive at from many directions, so apply even if you do not match every line above.
### How to apply
Send a CV/resume and a portfolio. The portfolio can be an ArtStation page, a personal site, a GitHub profile, an itch.io page, a reel, or a PDF. Which platform it lives on matters much less than whether we can open it and follow what we are looking at. If your work is spread across several places, link all of them and tell us which one to start with. If your resume doesn't explicitly have Tech Art, you're welcome to create a cover letter for us to review telling us why you're interested in this program. Cover letters are entirely optional.

## Role Purpose
The Hydrologist is responsible for providing specialist hydrological expertise to support water resource management, environmental compliance, and strategic planning activities across the organisation's operating regions. The role leads hydrological assessments and investigations that underpin key statutory programmes, including the Water Industry National Environment Programme (WINEP), Water Resource Management Plans (WRMP), and Drought Plans.
Acting as the organisation's expert client for hydrology, the postholder will analyse, interpret and communicate hydrological data and modelling outputs to assess environmental impacts, support water resource decision-making, and ensure compliance with environmental regulations and licence requirements. The role supports operations across Bournemouth Water, Bristol Water, South West Water (including the Isles of Scilly), and SES Water.
## Key Responsibilities
### Hydrological Leadership & Expertise
* Provide technical hydrological leadership and advice for key statutory programmes including WINEP, WRMP and Drought Plan development.
* Act as the subject matter expert for hydrology and hydrometry across water resources activities.
* Support environmental and water resource planning decisions through robust hydrological analysis and interpretation.
* Ensure compliance with environmental legislation, abstraction licences, permits and industry best practice.
### Hydrological Assessment & Analysis
* Undertake hydrological assessments associated with new and varied abstraction licence applications.
* Analyse the impacts of licence conditions, hands-off flows and abstraction regimes on water availability and environmental outcomes.
* Support drought permit applications and strategic drought planning activities.
* Deliver naturalised and de-naturalised flow assessments to support hydro-ecological modelling and environmental investigations.
* Undertake flow assessments to support fisheries and ecological studies.
* Support operational abstraction compliance monitoring and reporting.
### Data Management & Modelling
* Manage, maintain and improve naturalised flow models and associated analytical tools.
* Analyse and interpret hydrometric and environmental datasets to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
* Apply rainfall-runoff methodologies and hydrological modelling tools to support water resource assessments.
* Develop evidence-based recommendations to support operational and strategic decision-making.
### Hydrometry & Monitoring
* Support the design and delivery of hydrometric monitoring programmes and solutions.
* Review and develop stage-discharge rating curves where required.
* Assess flow measurement techniques, hydrological monitoring systems and data quality standards.
* Ensure monitoring activities provide robust evidence for regulatory and operational purposes.
### Stakeholder & Consultancy Management
* Build effective working relationships with regulators, including Environment Agency hydrology teams.
* Discuss modelling methodologies, hydrological assessments and monitoring approaches with external stakeholders.
* Specify, manage and review work undertaken by external hydrological consultants.
* Prepare scopes of work and evaluate consultant proposals and tenders.
## Person Specification
### Essential Knowledge & Experience
* Strong understanding of catchment hydrology and water resources management.
* Experience undertaking hydrological assessments, analysis and technical reviews.
* Experience analysing and interpreting hydrometric datasets.
* Ability to produce high-quality technical reports and present complex information clearly.
* Experience supporting low flow studies, drought assessments and water resource investigations.
### Technical Skills
* Hydrological assessment and catchment analysis.
* Hydrometric monitoring and flow measurement.
* Stage-discharge rating curve development and review.
* Rainfall-runoff modelling and hydrological forecasting.
* Technical report writing and stakeholder communication.
* Data analysis and interpretation.
* Project management and prioritisation.
* Analytical problem solving.
### Desirable Experience
* Use of hydrological modelling packages such as GR6J and Qube.
* Programming and analytical tool development using R or Python.
* Experience with GIS software and spatial analysis.
* Knowledge of groundwater-dominated catchments and regional hydrological characteristics.
* Experience working within the water industry environment.
* Hydrometric knowledge, including flow measurement techniques and monitoring infrastructure.
## Qualifications
### Essential
* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Environmental Science, Earth Sciences, Physical Geography or another relevant analytical discipline.
* Full UK Driving Licence.
### Desirable
* Master's Degree in a relevant subject.
* Minimum five years' experience delivering hydrological studies and catchment assessments.
* Professional membership of CIWEM or equivalent professional body.
* Chartered status or actively working towards chartership.

You will work on silicon platforms and real devices, analysing performance across complex and often non-deterministic environments. The role requires a solid foundation in CPU fundamentals, along with a strong interest in understanding how system-level behaviour maps to underlying microarchitecture.
Working alongside experienced architects and performance engineers, you will contribute to investigations, build supporting evidence, and help guide CPU design decisions.

As the Experimentation Senior Product Manager at ASOS, you'll own the experimentation capability end to end the standards experiments are designed to, the metrics they are measured against, the platform they run on, the data feeding their results, and the governance determining whether a result is trusted enough to act on. This role does not run individual experiments; it determines whether hundreds of experiments run by other people produce decisions the business can rely on.
ASOS runs experimentation at scale across Product, Engineering, Analytics, Trade and Data, and the volume of experiments isn't the constraint, the capability surrounding them is. This role owns the difference between those two states.
You'll define the vision and roadmap for how ASOS experiments, and be accountable for the quality and reliability of experimentation outcomes across the business, setting the standards experiments are held to and enforcing them through a weekly review cycle, owning the measurement foundations that determine whether results can be trusted, owning the experimentation platform and its strategy, and building the capability of the wider organisation through the Experimentation Forum, the Champion network, training and direct support to Product Managers.
The role is roughly 55% operational leadership — governance, programme delivery, stakeholder management, enablement, leadership reporting and vendor management — and 45% technical product leadership — measurement frameworks, statistical methodology, platform ownership, data and analytics integration, and AI and automation. The 45% is the distinguishing feature: a candidate who can run the programme but cannot challenge a metric definition or assess a Bayesian approach will deliver roughly half of what the role requires.
You'll collaborate with Product Analytics, Analytics Engineering, Engineering leaders and Trade partners to build a trusted, high-quality experimentation capability that drives faster and more confident product decisions.

* Drive adoption of advanced methodologies including Bayesian sequential testing, multivariant testing and multi-armed bandits, partnering with Analytics teams and external experts.

* Design AI-enabled experimentation workflows and agents, with governance for AI-assisted experimentation agreed before tooling deploys.

* Develop frameworks to measure the financial impact of experiments, connecting experiment outcomes to commercial value and business KPIs.

## Company Description
We're ASOS, the online retailer for fashion lovers all around the world.

## Job Description
The Threat & Exposure Management analyst helps ASOS understand and reduce the technology exposures most likely to contribute to material cyber risk. Rather than treating vulnerabilities in isolation, the role considers vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, identity and privilege weaknesses, cloud security risks, exposed assets and attack paths in the context of threat intelligence, exploitability and business criticality. You’ll turn technical security data into clear, risk-based priorities, helping engineering and technology teams focus remediation effort where it delivers the greatest reduction in exposure and cyber risk. This is an analytical and collaborative role. You’ll work across ASOS’s technology estate to understand what is exposed, how it could realistically be exploited, what an attacker could reach, what matters most to ASOS, and what we should do about it. **Role details**
* Identify and assess technology exposures across ASOS, including vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, identity and privilege weaknesses, exposed assets and services, cloud security risks and attack paths.
* Perform risk-based analysis and prioritisation, considering exploitability, threat intelligence, attacker behaviour, asset criticality, business context, accessibility and compensating controls to determine which exposures matter most.
* Analyse attack paths to understand how vulnerabilities, configurations, identities, privileges and trust relationships could combine to enable compromise of critical ASOS systems, services or data.
* Apply threat intelligence and exploitation data to understand which threats and exposures are most relevant to ASOS and where action should be prioritised.
* Assess exposure across modern technology environments, including cloud platforms, applications, APIs, virtual machines, containers, endpoints, identities, networks and supporting infrastructure.
* Support continuous attack-surface discovery, helping identify unknown, unmanaged, incorrectly classified or unexpectedly exposed assets and services.
* Partner with engineering, product, platform and infrastructure teams to agree proportionate remediation or mitigation strategies, focusing effort on actions that deliver the greatest reduction in cyber risk.
* Track significant exposures through to resolution, escalating material or persistent risk where appropriate and helping teams identify effective remediation or compensating controls.
* Identify recurring exposure patterns and systemic control weaknesses, working with technology teams to address root causes and eliminate classes of exposure rather than repeatedly treating individual findings.
* Assess the effectiveness of preventative and compensating controls in reducing identified exposures and attack paths, recommending improvements where required.
* Validate significant exposures and remediation outcomes, using appropriate technical evidence to confirm that identified risk has been materially reduced.
* Translate technical findings into clear risk insights, communicating exposure, potential business impact and remediation priorities to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Contribute to meaningful exposure metrics and reporting that demonstrate changes in organisational risk and remediation effectiveness rather than relying solely on vulnerability volumes or severity scores.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of ASOS’s Threat & Exposure Management capability, including automation, data enrichment, prioritisation models, metrics, reporting, workflow integration, processes and governance.
* Promote secure-by-design and proportionate, risk-based security practices across ASOS technology teams.
## Qualifications
**About You:**
* Relevant experience as a Vulnerability Analyst, SOC Analyst, or in a similar role.
* Understanding of common vulnerability types and attack techniques.
* Experience with vulnerability management, cloud security or security assessment tooling (e.g. Wiz, Defender, Nessus, Qualys or similar).
* Understanding of enterprise technologies, including cloud platforms, infrastructure, networking and software development practices.
* Ability to leverage threat intelligence to assess vulnerability risk and inform remediation priorities.
* Knowledge of container and Kubernetes security is desirable.
* Understanding of cyber security risk management principles and risk-based decision making.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for presenting technical information clearly to non-technical audiences.
* Naturally inquisitive, with the ability to investigate security risks across diverse technologies and identify potential threats to the organisation.
* Self-motivated with strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
## Additional Information
You don’t need to have worked in a role called Threat & Exposure Management before. We’re looking for someone who can combine technical security knowledge with curiosity, analytical thinking and an understanding of risk. **You’ll ideally have:**
* Relevant experience in exposure management, vulnerability management, cloud security, security engineering, threat intelligence, SOC/security operations, or another role involving the analysis of technology and cyber risk.
* A strong understanding of common vulnerabilities, security misconfigurations and attacker techniques across modern technology environments.
* Experience using vulnerability, exposure, cloud security or security assessment tooling such as Wiz, Microsoft Defender, Nessus, Qualys or equivalent platforms.
* An understanding of cloud platforms and cloud-native technologies, including virtual machines, containers and modern application architectures.
* An understanding of identity and privilege as part of the attack surface, and how identity weaknesses can contribute to attack paths.
* An understanding of attack paths and attacker behaviour, including how multiple weaknesses can be combined to reach critical assets or services.
* An understanding of cyber security risk management and the ability to make risk-based rather than severity-based decisions.
* Knowledge of container and Kubernetes security is desirable.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with a naturally inquisitive approach to investigating security issues across diverse technologies.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly and turn them into actionable priorities for different audiences.
* A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively with engineering and technology teams to achieve practical security outcomes.
**What success looks like** Success in this role isn’t measured by how many vulnerabilities you find or tickets you create. It’s measured by how effectively we understand and reduce the exposures that matter most to ASOS. You’ll help us move from vulnerability management based primarily on individual findings and severity scores towards a more continuous, threat-informed and risk-based approach to understanding and reducing our attack surface.

London
### **Join AutogenAI – Revolutionising Bid and Proposal Writing with generative AI**
AutogenAI is a leader in Generative AI SaaS, transforming how organisations create and optimise winning bids, tenders and proposals through cutting-edge natural language processing technology. We are one of the fastest-growing AI companies in the world, expanding rapidly to meet the increasing demand for AI-driven solutions across sectors. Our innovation stems from a belief that language technology will revolutionise business communication over the next decade. We empower our clients to grow faster and more efficiently by delivering bespoke AI language engines tailored to their needs, saving time, improving content quality, and boosting win rates in highly competitive markets. As we scale, we invite passionate professionals to join our journey of innovation, helping shape the future of AI-powered business solutions. ### Job Summary
As Head of Engineering at AutogenAI, you will own the technical strategy, operational health and engineering culture of a global engineering organisation spanning London and the US (New York and Washington DC). You will lead through 2–3 Tech Leads, ultimately accountable for the output, quality and wellbeing of a wider team of around 15 developers. This is a senior leadership role sitting within the Build function, reporting to the Chief Product Officer alongside Product, Design and GTM teams. You'll evolve the operational direction for engineering, scope the operational rigour needed to scale a fast-growing SaaS business, and ensure our engineering culture and practices keep pace with the demands of a global, always-on Enterprise AI product. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role for an experienced engineering leader with a passionate focus on culture, performance, quality and operational excellence.
You’ll be instrumental in the build and ongoing delivery of a continuous deployment culture. You will carefully balance speed and quality through clear expectation setting, true cross functional collaboration and a customer facing approach. **What You'll Be Responsible For** **Strategic Direction & Technical Leadership** * Own and evolve AutogenAI's technical strategy (in collaboration with our Chief Technical Architect) and engineering roadmap, ensuring alignment with product goals and company vision across all regions.
* Act as a senior technical voice at leadership level, partnering with the Chief People Officer and GTM to shape the direction of the Build operational strategy.
* Represent Engineering in customer facing scoping sessions with our top Enterprise clients.
* Make and own high-stakes decisions that affect the whole engineering organisation.
**Engineering Operations & Scaling** * Review, evolve and continuously improve the operational backbone of engineering: delivery processes, engineering standards, on-call and incident practices, and cross-team ways of working.
* Own engineering-wide operational excellence- monitoring, triage, incident response and recovery practices- ensuring reliability and resilience across a 24-hour global footprint.
* Establish metrics and reporting that give visibility into engineering health, delivery predictability and team performance to senior stakeholders.
**Leadership of Tech Leads & Wider Team** * Directly manage and develop 2–3 Tech Leads, providing coaching, career development and performance management.
* Hold ultimate accountability for the performance, growth and wellbeing of the wider ~15-person developer team, working through your Tech Leads to ensure consistent, high-quality line management across all regions.
* Develop an Engineering culture that celebrates ownership, accountability and quality.
* Build a strong bench of technical leadership talent, with a clear focus on succession planning as the team scales.
**Global & Cross-Functional Collaboration** * Lead a genuinely global organisation, ensuring consistent standards, culture and communication across London, NYC, Washington DC and Gold Coast, while being sensitive to regional nuances and time zone challenges.
* Partner closely with Product and Design leadership as part of the senior Build function leadership team, ensuring engineering strategy is tightly integrated with product and design strategy.
* Represent engineering in company-wide leadership discussions, budgeting and planning cycles.
**Culture & Process Building** * Define and embed engineering standards, best practices and a culture of knowledge-sharing across a distributed, multi-region team.
* Drive continuous improvement in how the engineering organisation works, identifying and resolving systemic pain points across teams.
* Foster an inclusive, high-performance culture that supports rapid growth without compromising codebase health or team wellbeing.
You'll be working across a full-stack technology base of TypeScript (React, NestJS, Express) and Python, with the opportunity to shape technical direction across the entire stack, even as your day-to-day focus shifts towards leadership and strategy. **What You'll Bring to the Team** * **Senior Engineering Leadership**: Proven experience leading engineering organisations at scale, including leading through other leaders (Tech Leads/Engineering Managers), not just individual contributors.
* **Operational Excellence**: A track record of building and improving engineering operations- delivery processes, incident management, reliability practices- in a fast-scaling environment.
* **Global Team Leadership**: Experience (or strong aptitude for) leading distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones, with the cultural awareness to lead effectively across geographies.
* **Strategic & Commercial Thinking**: Ability to connect technical strategy to business outcomes, and to operate confidently at a senior leadership table alongside Product, Design and People leadership.
* **People Leadership**: A genuine passion for developing leaders and teams, with experience managing managers and building succession pipelines.
* **Technical Credibility**: Strong technical background (TypeScript ecosystem experience highly relevant) sufficient to earn the trust and respect of a technical organisation, even while your role is primarily leadership-focused.
* **Change Leadership**: A track record of driving significant organisational or technical change, and building the case for it with stakeholders.
**Requirements** * **Experience**: 8+ years in software engineering, including 4+ years in senior engineering leadership roles (e.g. Head of Engineering, Director of Engineering, Engineering Manager of Managers).
* **Leadership Scope**: Demonstrated experience managing other engineering leaders (Tech Leads/EMs), not just direct management of individual engineers.
* **Global/Distributed Teams**: Experience leading engineering teams across multiple countries or time zones is highly desirable.
* **Technical Foundation**: Strong technical grounding, ideally with experience across TypeScript-based stacks (React, NestJS, Express) and/or Python; comfort with cloud infrastructure and DevOps practices (e.g. Kubernetes, Terraform).
* **Operational Rigour**: Demonstrated experience building engineering operations- incident management, monitoring, delivery processes- in a scaling SaaS environment.
* **Stakeholder Management**: Comfortable operating at senior leadership level, reporting into and partnering with C-suite/People leadership.
* **Enterprise SaaS Product:**Experience driving quality and speed of an Enterprise SaaS product during a high-growth phase (e.g. Series B–D or equivalent).
* **AI fluency:**Prior experience with AI-driven SaaS products, NLP, or LLMs.

* **Stock Options:** Meaningful equity in the company.
* **Retirement Plan:** Pension scheme to help secure your future.
* **Paid Time Off:**Unlimited vacation (Yes, you read right!)
* **Flexible Work Options:**Remote working arrangements
* **Private Healthcare:** Bupa Medical and Dental cover

**Job Title:** Residual Value Analyst in Car Rental Industry **Job Type:** Permanent Employment **Location:** Bracknell Head Office Based (Hybrid Working 4 days in office, 1 from home)
**Role Overview:**
We are looking for a data-driven Residual Value Analyst to own end-to-end Residual Value topics for an assigned group of countries within our international fleet. This is a broad, business-facing role: you will forecast residual values, set pricing reserves for remarketing, and evaluate new-vehicle deals for in-fleeting for a number of countries.
You will help create, develop and apply the central RV methodology to local market conditions, and act as the go-to RV partner for local Remarketing, Procurement, Finance and Fleet Planning teams in your countries. Comfortable presenting analysis and recommendations to senior stakeholders, adapting messaging to different audiences. • Comfortable managing competing priorities independently across multiple countries.

# Consultant - Senior Consultant, Policy and Market Reform

### About Baringa
Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.
The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.
Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.
Certified as a *Great Place to Work* around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the *Financial Times* in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by *Forbes* for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.
## Our Policy and Economics practice is looking for an experienced Consultant or Senior Consultant to join the team.
We support clients from policy development to delivery and capital deployment, from regulatory strategies to business case submissions, and from competition cases to expert opinion. Our economists, policy specialists, regulatory experts and techno-economic modellers work alongside governments, regulators, investors and corporates — shaping regulatory and policy frameworks, as well as decisions, which underpin multi-billion-pound investment across energy, utilities and wider infrastructure.
### What you will be doing
* Apply economic reasoning and quantitative analysis to assess the impact of policy and regulatory changes on energy markets, investors, consumers and other market participants.
* Develop robust analytical models and evidence-based insights to inform client decision-making on complex policy and market issues.
* Translate technical analysis into clear, compelling and commercially relevant recommendations for clients.
* Produce high-quality written outputs, including reports, presentations and briefing materials for senior client stakeholders.
* Contribute to business development activities, including proposal writing, discussions on client propositions, and the development of new service offerings.
* Build trusted relationships with clients and support the delivery of projects from inception through to final recommendations.
* Contribute to internal initiatives that strengthen the team's capabilities, analytical tools, intellectual property and market profile.
* Stay abreast of emerging policy, regulatory and market developments, identifying implications for clients and opportunities for new work.
### Your skills and experience
* You will have 3-7 years' experience in consulting, government, industry or a similar analytical role, with a focus on energy markets, policy or economics.
* You've conducted policy, regulatory or economic analysis and can demonstrate how your work has influenced business, investment or policy decisions.
* You will have experience using quantitative analysis, economic modelling or data analysis techniques to evaluate market or policy outcomes.
* You've produced high-quality written reports, presentations or consultation responses, translating complex analysis into clear and persuasive recommendations.
* You have a good understanding of energy markets and structures, underpinning policy and emerging trends.
* You've worked with clients or senior stakeholders to scope problems, communicate findings and deliver analytical projects to deadlines.
## What a career at Baringa will give you
### Putting People First.
### Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include:
* Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service.
* Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave.
* Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us.

# Senior FP&A Analyst
Liverpool
### **About Behavox**
Behavox is a cloud-native AI company providing an integrated controls platform for global banks, asset managers, hedge funds, private equity firms, insurance businesses, and commodity firms. The platform unifies communications and trade surveillance, compliant archiving, policy management as well as front-office analytics on a single, AI-native technology stack, delivered as a globally scalable SaaS-based cloud service.
At Behavox, our engineering culture is built around speed, experimentation, and technical excellence, following agile principles and rapid iteration. We constantly test and adopt the latest cloud technologies and AI tooling, optimising for fast feedback loops and execution. We look for people who can move fast, challenge conventional wisdom, and who want to work at the frontier of modern AI, SaaS platforms, and distributed systems.
Behavox is a high-performance organisation with a strong bias toward delivery, ownership, and responsibility. We commit, and we execute. We are building systems that are complex, mission-critical, and global in scale; systems that many consider too large or too difficult. To do that, we seek the smartest, most technically capable engineers and technologists who take end-to-end responsibility and want to win by building what others cannot.
Founded in 2014 and backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Behavox is headquartered in London, with offices worldwide, including New York City, Montreal, Seattle, Singapore, and Tokyo.
### **About the Role**
The Senior FP&A Analyst owns Behavox's core financial model — its architecture, the accounting beneath it, and the forecasts and analysis the company plans and decides by. The role exists to change decisions, not report them: it turns the numbers into the choices leadership actually faces. It reads and integrates budgets into the model, but does not run the budgeting cycle.
The same analyst builds the valuations, scenarios, and pro-forma models behind every acquisition — evaluating targets, running diligence, and folding closed deals into a single consolidated view. This work is periodic and must be carried alone when it arrives; the steady state is the operating model and SaaS forecasting.
This is a high-autonomy role that works without a detailed brief and sets the modeling standard others build on. It is accountable for the accuracy and integrity of the numbers, and for turning them into recommendations sharp enough to act on — the downside case included, not just the point estimate — for senior leadership, the board, and investors. It pressure-tests the assumptions behind every result, works fluently with modern tooling and AI, and compounds that edge by learning relentlessly. Its influence comes from the rigor and reach of the analysis, not from authority: it owns the model and the truth it tells, not the decisions made from it.
### **What You'll Bring**
1. **Financial Model & Accounting Foundations** — Understands the architecture of integrated three-statement and operating models and the accounting that underpins them, including SaaS revenue recognition and cost treatment. Understands how the company's budgets are built and how to integrate them accurately into the core financial model.
2. **Forecasting & SaaS Unit Economics** — Understands bottom-up short-term forecasting, driver-based long-term modeling, and the SaaS metrics that reveal business performance. Connects movements in those metrics to their underlying drivers and the operating levers that can change them.
3. **Mergers, Acquisitions & Integration** — Understands acquisition valuation, purchase accounting, combined-entity projections, and consolidation mechanics sufficiently to evaluate targets and integrate completed acquisitions into the financial model.
4. **Business & Commercial Acumen** — Understands in depth how the business and its functions generate revenue and incur costs, including the underlying revenue drivers, cost structure, and operating levers. Applies this knowledge to identify inconsistencies and challenge financial results and assumptions.
5. **Financial Systems & AI Tooling** — Understands Google Sheets, Excel, AI, and automation capabilities sufficiently to determine how they should be applied to financial modeling and analysis. Distinguishes where automation can improve speed and control from where financial judgment and manual validation must remain.
### **What You'll Do**
1. **Financial Model Ownership** — Builds and maintains the core three-statement and operating model using robust architecture, accounting logic, scenario and sensitivity layers, and integrated budgets, owning the accuracy of every output and the integrity of every assumption to provide reliable forecasts and analysis for company planning and decision-making.
2. **Acquisition Modeling & Integration** — Builds valuations, scenarios, and pro-forma combined-entity models by independently evaluating targets, supporting due diligence, and consolidating closed deals to provide a complete financial view of acquisition implications and the combined business.
3. **Business-Review Reporting** — Drives the financial substance of monthly, quarterly, and annual business reviews with the broader FP&A team by translating model outputs and performance drivers into a clear narrative that enables senior management, the board, and investors to understand results and their implications.
4. **Metrics Analysis & Business Partnering** — Diagnoses financial and SaaS metric movements by identifying operating drivers, pressure-testing assumptions, and modeling relevant levers and downside cases to give decision-makers evidence-based recommendations they can act on.
5. **AI-Enabled Productivity** — Applies AI and spreadsheet automation to recurring financial workflows by automating appropriate work and strengthening data validation while retaining judgment over what remains manual to reduce cycle time without compromising financial integrity.
### **What We Offer**
* The opportunity to work on a global, mission-critical AI platform alongside the best engineers and technologists across multiple geographies
* A role with real ownership and impact, building complex systems at scale in an environment that values speed, experimentation, and technical excellence
* A highly attractive benefits package, including competitive cash compensation, an equity award aligned with long-term value creation, and comprehensive health insurance for employees and their families
* A generous time-off policy of 30 days annually, plus public holidays and sick leave, recognizing the importance of sustained high performance

Inspired by Bitcoin's vision of financial freedom, we are committed to empowering individuals to transact and connect seamlessly across the globe. **Innovation**
At Bitfinex, we merge technology and skill to create an environment where your involvement isn’t just appreciated—it’s pioneering the future and pushing boundaries in finance. Our culture values bold creativity, a passion for technology, and a deep belief in Financial Freedom.

If you’re excited about partaking in shaping the narrative of decentralized finance, you’ll feel right at home!
#### **The Role:**
As a Transaction Monitoring Investigator, you will play a critical role in safeguarding the integrity of the Bitfinex platform by identifying, investigating, and mitigating financial crime risks across both fiat and cryptocurrency transactions. Working within the Compliance team, you will analyze transaction monitoring alerts, assess unusual account activity, and investigate potential money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions, and fraud-related risks using a risk-based approach. You will collaborate closely with AML Investigators, Product teams, and Compliance leadership to ensure timely escalation of high-risk cases, contribute to regulatory reporting and process improvements, and continuously enhance monitoring controls. This role requires strong analytical thinking, sound judgment, and a deep interest in cryptocurrency, blockchain transactions, and evolving AML/KYC regulations within a fast-paced global fintech environment.
#### **Your Day-to-Day:**
* Develop and implement transaction monitoring algorithms to monitor for anti-money laundering, terrorism financing, sanctions and other compliance risks to enable controls to be implemented to mitigate against detected risks using a risk-based approach.
* Analyze and investigate alerts generated by the transaction monitoring system arising from fiat money (wire and non-wire) and crypto (on-chain and off-chain) trades, deposits and withdrawals with a view to mitigate risk exposure to the platform, and escalate real time urgent alerts according to risk appetite.
* Assist the Manager Transaction Monitoring in building periodic specific and general reports providing analysis that identifies ML, TF and Sanctions related anomalies for the information of the Chief Compliance Officer and relevant Product Managers.
* As a member of the Transaction Monitoring Team, report directly to the Manager of Transaction Monitoring. Also, work closely with other Bitfinex teams and peer AML Investigators in addressing both fraud, and money laundering, terrorist financing, and sanctions risks.
* In performing this role, the incumbent will continuously strive to self-develop and enhance their skill sets including the application of virtual currencies, documentation requirements, and account behavior analysis in the context of KYC/AML/CTF and Sanctions.
* Duties include understanding the framework of our transaction monitoring rules on a risk-based approach as well as analyzing and evaluating data needed to assess referrals of unusual transaction activities.
* Ensure that KYC/AML/CTF and Sanctions activities are observed at all times, issues are addressed appropriately, and matters escalated to management as required. Further, identification and/or coordination of the implementation of process improvements relating to KYC/AML/CTF and Sanctions policies in conjunction with Bitfiex’s ToS as applicable are also imperative.
**This role’s Tactical Responsibilities also include:**
* Initial assessment of referrals of unusual transaction activity
* Report and analyze unusual documentation and/or information and/or query and/or transaction to/with Manager Investigations and Transaction Monitoring
* Adjust risk parameters to ensure exposure falls within the platform’s risk appetite
* Participate in applicable compliance training;
* Follow and implement KYC/AML/CTF and Sanctions-related policies, laws and regulations.
* Carry out cross-departmental communication when the need arises.
* Liaise with AML Analysts and/or users in respect of additional information required in order to verify the presence of ML/TF concerns when required.
* Undertake evaluation and communicate findings and decisions to respective case stream team leader; escalate and/or discuss with the Head of Investigations where required.
#### **What You Bring to the Table:**
* Experience in the compliance field within the Industry;
* Fair understanding or ability to understand AML/KYC/CTF related policies, laws and regulations, including enhanced due diligence, (CDD/EDD) and Sanctions;
* Basic knowledge of blockchain technology, (enhanced in the role); CAMS/CBP designation
* ​​Experience with a Blockchain Analytical/Transaction Monitoring tool such as Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM, etc.
* University degree
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to source and understand the content of documentation in various languages, types and forms
* Demonstrated critical thinking and decision-making skills
* Demonstrated attention to detail, accuracy and consistency
* Self-motivated (ability to take initiative)
* Proficient IT skills (Chrome, Open Search, Google Docs, Gmail, Word, Excel, etc.)
* Organisational understanding (enhanced in the role)

* You have been declared bankrupt, have a CCJ or an un-managed IVA.
* You have tattoos that are deemed offensive; tattoos on face and neck will be considered on a case-by-case basis.

## Job Introduction

We care deeply about what we do; serving the public and* *supporting* *our people. Our work matters.* *If you want to make a positive difference to the millions of people who use the network every day, BTP is the place for you**."* **– Chris Casey, Divisional Commander, London and South East England**
**Become a Police Officer in our B Division**
We are recruiting Police Officers at **Stevenage, Colchester, Southend, Brighton****and****Guildford.** ****\*\* Holding a valid full UK driving licence is essential for all locations included on this advert \*\*** **Please note:****We are only recruiting for the locations specified in this advert. If these locations are not suitable for you, we kindly ask that you wait for a future campaign that aligns better with your preferred location.
### Could this be the role for you?
As a Police Officer with British Transport Police, you'll play a vital role in keeping millions of passengers, railway staff and members of the public safe every day. Working across one of the busiest transport networks in the world, you'll face unique challenges, develop valuable skills and make a real difference to people's lives.
No two days are the same. One moment, you could be supporting a vulnerable person in crisis. The next, you might be responding to an emergency, investigating crime, safeguarding a child, disrupting criminal activity or reassuring someone during one of the most difficult moments of their life.
This is a career where your actions matter. Every interaction provides an opportunity to protect, support and positively impact the communities we serve.
You'll never face these challenges alone. From your first day of training, you'll be supported by experienced colleagues, supervisors and mentors who are committed to helping you develop, succeed and build a rewarding career.
We offer one of the most competitive starting salary packages for Police Constables in England and Wales, alongside excellent benefits, structured career development and opportunities to specialise throughout your policing career. **What you'll get in return**
A successful policing career is about more than salary alone. At British Transport Police, you'll benefit from competitive pay, industry-leading travel benefits, strong family-friendly policies, comprehensive wellbeing support and ongoing opportunities to develop both professionally and personally.
* **Starting salary:** **£33,609 (plus additional paid allowances stated below)**, rising year-on-year to **£52,014** after five years

* Oyster card for personal and professional use
* 25 days annual leave, increasing with service
* A highly competitive Career Average Revalued Earnings (CARE) pension scheme
* Voucher and incentive schemes, including cycle-to-work and a wide range of retail discounts
* Continued investment in learning, supported by dedicated in-house talent and development teams
* Clear promotion and career development opportunities across a range of policing specialisms
* Specialist support from Occupational Health and wellbeing services
* Free eyesight tests
* Eligibility for the Blue Light Card
* Membership of the Police Federation from day one
* Strong support for work-life balance, including 26 weeks of fully paid maternity leave, alongside paternity leave, carers' leave, adoption leave and special leave provisions
### What we're looking for
You do not need previous policing experience to join us. We welcome applications from people from all backgrounds, experiences and stages of life.
Whether you're changing careers, leaving education, returning to work or looking for a fresh challenge, we'll provide the training, support and development you need to succeed. There is no single background that makes a great police officer. Some of our officers join directly from education, while others bring valuable experience from careers in healthcare, customer service, retail, hospitality, transportation, the military and many other professions.
What matters most is your integrity, commitment to helping others and willingness to learn. If you care about people, enjoy working as part of a team and want to make a difference, we'd love to hear from you. While every day brings different challenges, successful officers are often people who communicate effectively, remain calm under pressure and can build positive relationships with people from all walks of life.
**Key qualities include:**
* Strong communication skills
* Sound judgement and problem-solving ability
* Empathy and emotional resilience
* The ability to build trust and remain calm under pressure
**Police Constable Entry Programme (PCEP)**
Successful candidates will join the Police Constable Entry Programme (PCEP), British Transport Police's two-year entry route for new police officers.
You do not need a degree to apply and you will not be required to complete a degree as part of the programme.
PCEP combines classroom learning, remote learning, scenario-based training and practical operational experience to equip you with the knowledge, skills and behaviours needed for frontline policing.
During training, you'll learn how to:
* Use policing powers lawfully and effectively
* Prevent and investigate crime
* Protect vulnerable people
* Respond to incidents and emergencies
* Support victims and witnesses
* Keep passengers, railway staff and local communities safe
As your career develops, you'll have opportunities to specialise in areas such as CID, Counter Terrorism and County Lines. Whether you aspire to become a detective, join a specialist unit, develop as a leader or continue building expertise in frontline policing, we'll support your ambitions every step of the way.
**Entry Requirements**
To be eligible to apply for the Police Constable Entry Programme (PCEP), you must have:
**LEVEL 2**
* Level 2 qualifications in English Language and Maths (GCSE Grade C/4 or above, or an accepted equivalent qualification), **OR**
* be willing to undertake BTP's Level 2 English and Maths assessment if you do not currently hold these qualifications,
**LEVEL 3 OR WORK EXPERIENCE**
**In addition to the above you are also required to have:**
* A Level 3 qualification or above (details below), **OR**
* Have relevant work experience demonstrating an equivalent level of knowledge, responsibility and professional capability (details below)
**Examples of Level 3 qualifications include:**
* Two A-levels at grade E or above (or equivalent, such as a BTEC Level 3, Level 3 T Levels or International Baccalaureate(IB)).
* BTEC National Diploma
* NVQ Level 3
* Access to Higher Education Diploma
* Other recognised Level 3 qualifications
* Policing experience: at least 12 months' relevant experience, including service as a Special Constable (independent patrol status), PCSO and staff. **OR**
**Work Experience**
We recognise that qualifications are only one measure of potential. If you do not hold a Level 3 qualification, we may consider relevant work experience as an alternative route into policing.
Relevant work experience (24 months service) in one of the following areas:
* Armed Forces / Military service
* Emergency services (e.g. ambulance, fire)
* Revenue Protection Officer / Revenue Inspector
* Railway Enforcement Officer
* Rail Incident Response or Service Delivery Management roles
Candidates will be required to provide evidence of their qualifications and/or experience during the recruitment process. **You will not be eligible to apply if:**
* You cannot demonstrate either a Level 3 qualification OR relevant work experience equivalent to Level 3.

* You have been declined/refused vetting in the last two years by BTP or any other police force, NCA, CNC or MOD.

* You are bankrupt, have a County Court Judgment, or an unmanaged Individual Voluntary Arrangement.
* You have tattoos deemed offensive (face and neck tattoos are considered on a case-by-case basis).
* You do not have permanent right to live and work in the UK.
* You have not resided continuously in the UK for the past three years.
### Want to apply?
Applications are completed online.
As part of the process, you will be required to complete Situational Judgement Test's. If you do not pass the SJT assessments, your application will not progress at this time, though you may reapply once the reapplication period allows.
You are encouraged, though not required, to attend a question-and-answer session to learn more about the role, life at BTP and the recruitment process.
Please note: This campaign is for new recruits only. Transferees should apply through a transferee-specific vacancy when available.
Successful applicants will join a conditional offer pool and be considered for opportunities for up to 12 months from the date of their conditional offer.
### Equality, Diversity and Inclusion
We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to thrive.
We believe our people are strongest when they reflect the diverse communities we serve, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences.
Whatever your background, identity or experience, you'll be supported throughout the recruitment process and throughout your career with British Transport Police.
Reasonable adjustments are available at every stage of the recruitment process.

AI can be a useful tool for generating ideas or helping structure written responses, but we want to hear your genuine voice. Personal experiences, authentic motivation and individual insight are what stand out most to us.

We are a talented global team based in the UK, Canada and USA. **Role Summary:**
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to shape the products and services Cambridge Cognition provides to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies for use in clinical trials. This is a strategic, commercially minded role at the intersection of customer needs, science, technology, regulation and drug development.
You will identify important customer problems, assess market opportunities and translate insight into product strategy and investment decisions. This includes building rigorous commercial cases using market sizing, pricing and revenue assumptions, costs, ROI and sensitivity analysis, while understanding the scientific, regulatory and operational evidence required for adoption in clinical trials.

**Commercial Strategy & Business Cases**
* Build commercial cases for product investments and new markets, combining customer evidence with TAM/SAM, expected adoption, pricing, revenue potential, development and operating costs, margin and strategic fit.
* Develop ROI and financial models, including payback periods, scenario and sensitivity analysis, with clear assumptions around price, volume, adoption and cost.
* Partner with Finance and Commercial teams to test assumptions, define measurable success criteria, and revisit investment cases as evidence develops.
* Contribute to pricing, packaging and business-model decisions for products and services sold into pharmaceutical clinical development.

* Lead cross-functional product initiatives, communicate product decisions and trade-offs clearly, and monitor success through adoption, commercial performance, customer feedback and relevant KPIs.

**Essential Requirements:**
* Significant product management, product strategy or closely related experience within life sciences, healthcare, clinical research or another highly regulated technology market.
* Demonstrated experience conducting qualitative customer discovery and synthesising findings into clear opportunities and product priorities.
* Strong market and commercial analysis skills, including market sizing, segmentation, competitor analysis and building business cases with ROI, revenue forecasts, cost assumptions and scenario/sensitivity analysis.
* Ability to translate ambiguous customer and market problems into product strategy, requirements and evidence-based prioritisation decisions.
* Experience working with scientific and technical teams on complex products where decisions require consideration of evidence, data and feasibility.

# Senior DevOps Engineer
London, UK
Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to **Unleash the Potential** of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it. Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.
We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes’ health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.
Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success.
### **WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT PLATFORM ENGINEERING**
We are looking for a talented and inquisitive Senior DevOps Engineer whose drive for learning and determination for continuous improvement aligns with our ambitious, fast-growing and transforming company. Based in our London office, you will be a key player in planning, designing, building and testing the features of our next-generation cloud platform that combines digital video assets, wearable data and athlete information to provide insights and analytics to coaching/support staff, sports scientists and athletes to assist in optimizing athlete performance. We believe that our customers deserve the best platform and we are on a mission to maximize and enhance their performance through delivering a high-quality experience. Our software and DevOps engineers match this ethos by taking responsibility for constantly improving productivity and development of self and be able to excel in a fast-paced environment with short project timelines from conception to deployment.
### **WHAT YOU’LL DO**
* Cloud & Platform Engineering
+ Infrastructure Automation & IaC: Own infrastructure provisioning and configuration management (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
+ Observability & Reliability: Design, build and maintain logging, monitoring, alerting, and SLO/SLI frameworks to ensure system health and performance.
+ Software Delivery Pipelines: Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable fast, safe, and repeatable software delivery.
+ Infrastructure Operations & Governance: Oversee the availability, scalability, and performance of cloud and on-prem infrastructure while ensuring all systems remain strictly aligned with corporate security standards and global regulatory compliance.
* Cloud Security
+ Cloud Security & Compliance: Ensure compliance with relevant compliance and regulatory frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR as applicable) and implement best practices cloud security controls.
+ Security Operation: Lead security first approach, collaborate with Security and IT teams to make sure our infrastructure is patched according to SLAs.
+ Application Security (AppSec): Collaborate with security teams to embed security controls into CI/CD pipelines and platform services.
* Technology leader
+ Architectural Roadmap & Vision: Define and execute the long-term technical roadmap for Catapult’s global cloud platform, evaluating emerging technologies (e.g., Serverless, AI-driven operations, and Containerization) to ensure the infrastructure remains cutting-edge, scalable, and best to used by our customers.
+ Technical Governance & Standards: Be a big contribution to infrastructure decisions, establishing "Golden Paths" and reusable Infrastructure as Code patterns that dictate how engineering teams deploy services while ensuring consistency across all environments.
+ Strategic Security & Compliance Integration: Architect and champion a "Shift-Left" security strategy, mandating the integration of automated security guardrails and compliance auditing into the core fabric of the CI/CD pipelines to protect athlete and video data globally.
### **WHAT YOU’LL NEED**
* Significant experience in DevOps, Site Reliability, Platform or Infrastructure Engineering, with tenure in technical leadership role.
* Deep expertise in the AWS cloud platform and associated security and compliance practices.
* Strong background in infrastructure automation (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.
* Proven experience with big platform re-design, architecture of new cloud infrastructure systems based on software and business requirements.
* Solid understanding of AppSec principles, including integrating security into build and deploy pipelines.
* Experience managing hybrid environments, including traditional data centers and on-prem services.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to influence across engineering, security, and finance.
* Experience with regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, fintech).
* Familiarity with multiple compliance frameworks (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS).
### **WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE**
In 6 months time...
By the half-year mark, you will have moved beyond the onboarding phase to become the primary authority on Catapult’s infrastructure.
* Infrastructure Ownership: You will fully own the cloud infrastructure, having gained a deep understanding of all interconnected parts that support their athlete and video data services.
* Established Automation: You will have taken control of infrastructure provisioning and configuration management, ensuring that Terraform or Ansible are being used effectively for IaC.
* Observability Implementation: You will have designed and begun maintaining essential logging, monitoring, and SLO/SLI frameworks to ensure high system health and performance.
* Have a full understanding of Catapult’s products and the way we are working in order to be able to architect any new future existing or new product.
In 12 months time...
By the end of your first year, you will be driving the "next generation" of Catapult’s technology stack and leading cross-functional improvements.
* End to End Platform Ownership: You will take full accountability for the evolution of our production ecosystem, architecting a resilient, "deploy-anywhere" infrastructure that scales seamlessly with software demands and business growth.
* Optimized Delivery: You will have refined the CI/CD pipelines to a state where software delivery is consistently fast, safe, and repeatable across the engineering team.
* Integrated Security and Compliance: You will have transitioned the platform to a "security-first" architecture, successfully embedding automated AppSec controls and vulnerability scanning directly into the CI/CD pipelines.
* Cross-Departmental Influence: Your success will be reflected in your ability to influence stakeholders across engineering, security, and finance to drive technical and operational improvements.
**WHY CATAPULT?**
* We have amazing people. We promise you’ll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
* We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary.
* We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
* Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.
* We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.
Whether you’re interested in sports or not, you’ll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet!
Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.
All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.
