# Senior Consultant - Digitisation & Traffic Orders
**Senior Consultant - Digitisation & Traffic Orders**
**Newbury - Hybrid**
***Do you want to help shape software that affects thousands of lives?***
Who are we?
We are ranked as the UK’s #1 construction specific software player and our mission is simple; to provide market leading end-to-end software solutions to the construction and construction like industries across the entire build life cycle.
If you are looking to build an exceptional career with an award-winning company you’ve come to the right place. Our teams are based in the UK, Europe, US, and India, working on products that are used on a global scale. We have a clear and defined road map to deliver over the next 3 years, which is centred around a large-scale digital transformation as well as continuing our growth and expansion.
We embrace diversity and equality and want our employees to be comfortable bringing their whole selves to work. We are committed to building a team with a variety of backgrounds, skills and views. Creating a culture of Equality isn’t just the right thing to do, it improves every aspect of our business.
**Purpose**
The purpose of the Senior Consultant role is to manage the delivery of consultancy services that help customers adopt and realise value from Causeway’s integrated platform. As a senior expert in Traffic Regulation and Traffic Regulation Orders (TROs), the role provides trusted guidance to customers and internal teams to embed best-practice digital workflows and maximise the effectiveness of Causeway’s solutions.
In supporting Causeway’s shift to a platform-first model, the Senior Consultant plays a key role in delivering multi-product services, strengthening cross-functional collaboration, and contributing to scalable service approaches that drive customer success and business growth.
**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Delivery & Client Engagement**
• Manage and deliver consultancy projects that span multiple Causeway products, supporting discovery, configuration, integration, testing, and value realisation across platform workflows.
• Act as the primary interface with customers, ensuring strong stakeholder engagement, clarity of requirements, and coordinated delivery that reflects Causeway’s platform-wide capabilities.
• Produce high-quality project deliverables including business cases, data workflows, TRO and non-TRO configuration outputs, platform adoption plans, and risk/issue management artefacts aligned to industry legislation and digital best practice.
**Technical Expertise, Platform Knowledge Leadership & Team Development**
• Provide expert advice on Traffic Regulation and TRO processes while extending this insight into broader platform-led solutions that connect mapping, data management, asset management, or other Causeway capabilities.
• Work collaboratively with Product, Professional Services, Support, and Commercial teams, providing expert insight into political, legislative, and market drivers to help shape multi-product solutions, guide product roadmaps, and support the development of scalable, service-ready platform features.
• Mentor colleagues and contribute to internal knowledge development by supporting training materials, cross-product enablement sessions, and internal capability building that aligns to Causeway’s strategic shift toward platform delivery.
**Business Development, Enablement & Continuous Improvement**
• Identify opportunities for customers to expand their use of Causeway’s platform, including adoption of new modules, integrations, or enhanced workflows that deliver compound value across multiple products.
• Contribute to the development of multi-product proposals, proofs of concept, solution designs, and commercial offerings that articulate Causeway’s evolving platform story and value proposition.
• Champion service-led innovation, feeding insights into process improvements, product enhancements, and service models that support scalable, platform-aligned delivery and operational excellence.
**Key Skills, Experience and Qualifications**
• Strong consultancy experience within a software or technology-enabled services environment, with proven ability to deliver complex, multi-stakeholder projects that may span multiple software products or workflows.
• Deep domain knowledge in Traffic Regulation and TRO processes, with the ability to contextualise this expertise within broader digital, mapping, and operational frameworks that connect into a platform ecosystem.
• Confident communication, facilitation, and analytical skills, enabling clear translation of customer needs into actionable platform solutions and well-structured documentation.
• Desirable: Chartered Engineer status (e.g. CIHT) or membership of a leading industry body, such as IHE or BPA.
• Degree or professional experience in relevant fields such as traffic management, transportation, GIS/mapping, engineering, or digital platforms.
• Project management certification (e.g. PRINCE2, APM) desirable.
• Ongoing CPD in Traffic Regulation, digital transformation, mapping technologies, or SaaS implementation is advantageous.
• Membership of, or active progression toward, recognised industry bodies such as the Chartered Institution of Highways & Transportation (CIHT), the Institute of Highway Engineers (IHE), or the British Parking Association (BPA) is desirable.
**Our Values**
We are**United**. As part of a team, we’re better together.
We are **Agile**. Be the change, we’re on a journey.
We are **Trusted**. Do the right thing, we own this.
We are **Driven**. Get stuck in, we make it happen.
**Benefits**
As a leader in employee engagement and people management, there are fantastic benefits and rewards at Causeway. We strive, year on year, to achieve recognition as an award-winning workplace that our employees love. We’ve selected just a few of the many benefits available below to show you how we take care of our Causeway stars.
* 25 days annual leave + public holidays, increasing with length of service.
* 4% matched pension.
* Income protection and life assurance.
* Access to our award-winning benefits platform.
* We take mental health seriously and have a dedicated EAP available 24/7.
* £100 allowance towards a fitness club.
* Private Medical Insurance.
* Paid study leave + volunteering days.
* Electric Car Scheme.
Like all responsible companies Causeway is aware of the need to recognise the importance of protecting our environment and addressing the climate emergency. Causeway is a carbon neutral company and we offset our calculated carbon footprint. However, we recognise that offsetting is not a permanent solution, so we set environmental objectives to reduce our footprint year-on-year.

## Company Description
**Who We Are**
Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.
We are feeding the world’s curiosity!
## Job Description
**We are looking for an experienced Senior Salesforce Administrator to lead the day-to-day stewardship and continued evolution of our Salesforce ecosystem. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will guide and develop a team, own critical platform controls, and remain directly involved in the design, configuration, release and support of business-critical solutions.**
**The role is accountable for the reliability, security, scalability and maintainability of our Salesforce estate, with particular focus on Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and the APIs and integrations that connect Salesforce to Slack and other enterprise platforms. You will balance rapid delivery with strong governance, helping the organisation get more value from Salesforce without increasing operational or security risk.**
**What you will be accountable for**
**1. Team leadership and operating model**
* Lead and develop the Salesforce team, setting clear priorities, standards and expectations while creating an environment of ownership, learning and constructive challenge.
* Act as the senior escalation point, providing calm, evidence-led direction during incidents, complex delivery decisions and stakeholder conflicts.
* Shape the team operating model, including capacity planning, work allocation, skills development, recruitment support and the effective use of specialist partners.
* Build sustainable capability, through coaching, documentation, peer review and reducing dependency on individual team members or external suppliers.
**2. Salesforce platform ownership**
* Own the health and evolution of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud, ensuring the platform supports commercial, customer-service and operational processes effectively.
* Set and enforce platform standards, covering configuration, automation, data models, naming conventions, documentation, testing and technical debt.
* Remain hands-on where needed, including complex Flow automation, permissions, validation rules, objects, page layouts, Lightning pages, reports, dashboards, analytics and troubleshooting.
* Own day-to-day system administration, including user administration, joiner/mover/leaver processing, delegated administration and routine platform hygiene.
* Configure and maintain Experience Cloud portals, including external sharing rules, guest user access, community settings, and partner- or customer-facing experiences.
* Maintain a clear platform roadmap that balances strategic improvements, regulatory or security obligations, operational resilience, and business demand.
* Control platform lifecycle changes, including Salesforce seasonal releases, feature adoption, deprecations, sandbox strategy and environment management.
* Evaluate and deploy AppExchange packages, assessing them against business requirements, security review status, licence cost, support model and long-term maintainability.
**3. Integrations, APIs and operational monitoring**
* Own the operational oversight of Salesforce integrations, including interfaces with Slack and other core enterprise applications.
* Administer and maintain key business integrations.
* Establish effective Slack API monitoring to cover authentication failures, token or certificate expirations, API errors, rate limits, latency, message delivery failures, and unexpected usage patterns.
* Define monitoring and alerting standards, with meaningful thresholds, named owners, support runbooks, escalation paths and service-level expectations.
* Protect integration reliability by overseeing connected apps, OAuth scopes, named credentials, integration users, event-driven services and API consumption.
* Lead incident response and problem management, ensuring root causes are understood, corrective actions are completed and recurring failures are designed out.
**4. Security, access and control posture**
* Own the Salesforce security posture, working with Security, IT and Risk teams to maintain proportionate, auditable controls.
* Design and maintain the org-wide sharing and security architecture, including organisation-wide defaults (OWD), role hierarchy, sharing rules, permission sets and permission-set groups, and field-level security.
* Apply least-privilege access, with appropriate segregation of duties and regular remediation of accumulated or excessive entitlements.
* Govern identities and privileged access, including SSO and MFA (working knowledge of Okta or a comparable identity provider), service accounts, integration users, delegated administration and joiner/mover/leaver controls.
* Lead regular security audits and access reviews to evidence least-privilege compliance and drive timely remediation of findings.
* Partner with IT and Security on platform audits and compliance, including SOC 2 and GDPR obligations, control evidence and audit response.
* Review platform risk signals, such as login anomalies, API usage, configuration changes, installed packages and connected-app behaviour, using the monitoring capabilities available in the Salesforce estate.
* Protect sensitive information through sound data-access design, retention controls, masking or anonymisation in non-production environments, and responsible vendor access.
**5. Licensing, certificates and lifecycle management**
* Optimise licence usage and forecasting across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud, including reharvesting, right-sizing and renewal input.
* Monitor and manage certificate lifecycles, including SSL and SAML signing certificates, to prevent avoidable authentication or integration outages.
* Manage connected app and OAuth lifecycles, with a maintained inventory, named owners, expiry tracking and proactive renewal ahead of failure.
* Provide clear cost and entitlement visibility, so licence, package and integration spend is understood, challenged and aligned to realised value.
**6. Delivery, release and DevOps**
* Own a transparent and prioritised delivery backlog, working with business stakeholders to clarify outcomes, value, dependencies and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain disciplined release management, with source control, peer review, automated or repeatable deployment, regression testing, rollback planning and release communications.
* Execute version-controlled releases through GitHub, using branch strategy, pull requests, peer approval and traceable change history as the standard route to production.
* Maintain documentation for all configuration and change management, so the estate remains understandable, auditable and supportable by more than one person.
* Improve platform support, using clear service measures, triage processes, knowledge articles, problem records and trend analysis.
* Manage technical debt deliberately, making risks and trade-offs visible and ensuring remediation is planned alongside new demand.
* Partner effectively with vendors, holding delivery partners to clear outcomes, quality standards, documentation and knowledge-transfer commitments.
**7. Data quality and platform insight**
* Champion trustworthy Salesforce data, including ownership, validation, duplicate management, integration reconciliation and remediation of recurring data-quality issues.
* Provide actionable platform insight, using dashboards and regular reporting on adoption, automation failures, API consumption, incidents, release quality, access risk and technical debt.
* Support sound architecture decisions, challenging unnecessary customisation and promoting maintainable, scalable use of standard Salesforce capabilities and enterprise-level data modelling.
**8. AI, Agentforce and emerging capabilities**
* Help evaluate and safely adopt Agentforce, Salesforce AI capabilities and adjacent enterprise AI tools where they can improve employee or customer outcomes.
* Support responsible AI governance, including data access, grounding, human oversight, prompt and agent testing, monitoring, auditability and change control.
* Contribute practical experience with Claude or comparable models, especially where AI services interact with Salesforce, Slack, knowledge content, workflows or customer data.
* Separate experimentation from production readiness, ensuring AI-enabled solutions meet the same security, reliability and support standards as other business-critical capabilities.
**Leadership behaviours**
* Service-minded ownership: you treat Salesforce as a critical business service, not simply a collection of projects.
* Wise pragmatism: you balance speed, usability, maintainability, cost and risk rather than optimising for only one dimension.
* Constructive challenge: you can say no, or not yet, with clear evidence and a practical route forward.
* Calm accountability: you take ownership when problems arise without creating blame or hiding uncomfortable facts.
* Enabling leadership: you give people clarity and support while building their confidence, judgement and independence.
* Clear communication: you make technical issues understandable and keep stakeholders informed before uncertainty becomes surprise.
**Key working relationships**
**The role will work closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Customer Service, Finance, Security, Enterprise Architecture, IT Operations, Data and Integration teams, as well as Salesforce and specialist implementation partners.**
## Qualifications
**Essential**
* 7+ years as a Salesforce Administrator in large, multi-team environments, with substantial hands-on responsibility for administration, configuration and operational support in a complex production environment.
* Salesforce Administrator certification (required).
* Proven people leadership, including line management, coaching, performance support, work prioritisation and development of Salesforce administrators or platform specialists.
* Deep practical knowledge of Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, including their security, automation, data and service-management implications.
* Deep Salesforce security expertise, covering organisation-wide defaults, role hierarchies, sharing models, permission sets, field-level security, identity, privileged access, connected apps and audit controls.
* Hands-on Experience Cloud capability, including external sharing models, guest access and community configuration.
* Proven Salesforce DevOps and change-management experience using GitHub, including version-controlled deployment workflows, pull-request review and release governance.
* Experience operating API-led integrations, including monitoring, troubleshooting, authentication, limits, failure handling and coordination across technical teams.
* Experience managing SSL and authentication certificates and maintaining integration health.
* Strong declarative delivery capability, particularly Flow, data modelling, validation, Lightning configuration, reporting and environment management.
* Sound release and change-management experience, including sandbox strategy, source control, testing, deployment governance and production support.
* Confident stakeholder management, with the ability to translate between commercial priorities, user needs, technical constraints and risk.
* Strong solution and design judgement, with a good understanding of platform architecture and enterprise-level data modelling.
**Desirable**
* Salesforce Advanced Administrator certification (preferred), or other relevant credentials such as Platform App Builder, Service Cloud Consultant or an appropriate Agentforce/AI accreditation.
* Experience administering Ironclad, Qualtrics and Slack CRM / Sales Elevate, or directly comparable CLM, survey and Slack-CRM tooling.
* Agentforce or Salesforce AI experience, including agent design, grounding, guardrails, evaluation or operational monitoring.
* Experience with Claude or other enterprise AI platforms, particularly in governed, data-sensitive business workflows.
* Experience with Slack platform capabilities and APIs, including enterprise integrations, apps, workflows, authentication and observability.
* Working knowledge of Okta or a comparable enterprise identity provider.
* Exposure to complementary enterprise platforms, such as NetSuite, MuleSoft, Celigo, Boomi, Workato, Zapier, identity providers or data platforms.
* Experience in a SaaS, technology or high-growth environment, where Salesforce supports complex B2B go-to-market and customer-service processes

## Description
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science. We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world. World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.
Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.
### About the role
*\*Open to hiring remote across North America and the UK— we also have offices in NYC, San Francisco, Seattle, and London. For this role, for UK hires at least 5 hours of overlap with US Pacific Time is expected.*
We’re looking for a passionate Product Manager to help us develop cutting-edge AI tools. This role is for someone who has a combination of strong technical or ML background and experience in product management. You have the ability to take the state-of-the-art AI systems our research team builds and turn them into impactful tools for our customers.
You’ll deeply understand what users want, what’s possible to build, and what’s strategic for our business. You’ll be a bridge between our users and our internal teams so we ship products that have the most value for Runway’s creators.
This role is a fundamental and critical part of the team for a market-defining company in its early stages.
### What you’ll do
* Work alongside our research team to define new AI applications that solve customer needs and drive business value
* Collaborate closely with engineering and design to productize research and continuously improve existing tools
* Define and analyze metrics, talk with users weekly, and conduct A/B tests to discover use cases, validate pain points, and prioritize features
### What you’ll need
* 1+ years of direct experience with SQL, python, code generation tools, and version control best practices
* 3+ years of product management experience
* Familiarity with the current state-of-the-art ML capabilities and ML products
* Experience working with fast-moving teams and building products from scratch
* Passion for seeing research through from initial conception to ultimate application
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

# Associate Director - International Tax
London, UK
**About Clear Street:** Clear Street is modernizing the brokerage ecosystem. Founded in 2018, Clear Street is a diversified financial services firm replacing the legacy infrastructure used across capital markets. We started from scratch by building a completely cloud-native clearing and custody system designed for today’s complex, global market. Clear Street’s proprietary prime brokerage platform adds significant efficiency to the market, while focusing on minimizing risk, redundancy, and cost for clients. Our goal is to create a single source-of-truth platform for every asset class, in every country, and in any currency. By combining highly-skilled product and engineering talent with seasoned finance professionals, we’re building the essentials to compete in today’s fast-paced markets. **The Role:** We are seeking an experienced Tax Associate Director (or Director) to lead tax matters across our UK, EMEA, and APAC operations. Based out of our London office in the United Kingdom, this is a high-impact individual contributor role within a fast-growing fintech business and will report locally to the UK Finance Director. The individual will act as a strategic leader responsible for managing corporate tax compliance and reporting, transfer pricing, planning and advisory and risk management across the UK, EU and APAC regions to strengthen the overall global tax and, more broadly, finance functions for the Company and support the needs of a rapidly growing organization. We are looking for someone who is excited to join a fast-paced organization and contribute to building a best-in-class Tax function as the Company continues to scale across businesses and geographies. The team is lean and the scope of the role is broad and so the position offers significant opportunities for leadership and growth. You will serve as the primary tax authority for a complex, multi-jurisdictional enterprise, advising senior business leaders, managing external advisors, and partnering with financial, legal, HR, and product teams to ensure tax efficiency, compliance and strategic alignment. **Responsibilities:**
*Tax compliance and reporting:*
* Manage end-to-end tax compliance cycle including, but not limited to, the preparation and/or review and filing of corporate income tax returns, VAT/GST and/or withholding taxes using local external advisors, where appropriate.
* Oversee the calculation and review of current and deferred tax provisions under IFRS / US GAAP for regional entities.
* Ensure timely and accurate tax disclosures in statutory financial statements.
*Tax planning and advisory:*
* Collaborate with Head of Tax on global tax strategy ensuring regional alignment with overall group-wide objectives.
* Assist with development and implementation of tax planning initiatives, identifying opportunities to optimize effective tax rate and maximize efficiency and tax savings.
* Assist with M&A tax due diligence and post-acquisition tax integration and legal entity rationalization workstreams, including holding structures and IP ownership.
* Act as internal tax advisor for various business units and stakeholders, including, but not limited to, finance, legal, operations and HR.
* Monitor legislative and regulatory developments in UK, EMEA, and APAC jurisdictions (including Pillar Two / BEPS) and assess impact on the business.
*Tax Risk Management:*
* Support global transfer pricing policies, including local file requirements and ensuring intercompany agreements are properly documented.
* Identify and assess issues and tax implications across UK, EMEA and APAC subsidiaries; maintain robust internal controls are in place to ensure compliance and mitigate tax risk.
* Manage relationship with tax authorities (i.e., HMRC) and assist with support for tax controversy and audits/examinations.
*Other:*
* Assist with the design and implementation of technology automation initiatives with respect to financial reporting and tax compliance.
* Assist in operational aspects of the tax function to support tax needs. Gain a deep understanding of the company’s operations, businesses and develop a strong network beyond the tax department.
* Assist with special projects and initiatives, as necessary, including systems implementation and automation processes.
* Support other tax workstreams, if needed (e.g., FATCA/CRS).
**Skills & Attributes:** * Significant hands-on tax experience and in-depth understanding of UK, EMEA and Asia corporate tax gained in-house at a multinational company.
* Exceptional technical knowledge of international tax principles
* ACA, CTA, or equivalent professional qualification preferred (or international equivalent).
* Deep expertise in UK corporate tax is essential; strong knowledge of EMEA and APAC tax regimes strongly preferred.
* Proven track record managing transfer pricing frameworks in a multi-jurisdictional setting
* Experience supporting new business development and M&A transactions, including due diligence, structuring and integration.
* Background in financial services and/or fintech and understanding of the securities industry and broker-dealer businesses including understanding of financial products is highly desired
* Strong project management, planning, and organizational skills including the ability to prioritize multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Self-starter with the ability to work well independently as well as within a team environment with excellent interpersonal skills.
* Collaborative working style with cross functional/business segment teams across geographies.
**We Offer:**
At Clear Street, we offer competitive compensation packages, company equity, pension, gender neutral parental leave, and full medical and dental insurance. Our belief has always been that we are better as a business when we are all together in person. As such, we are requiring employees to be in the office a minimum of three days per week.
Our top priority is our people. We’re continuously investing in a culture that promotes collaboration. We help each other through challenges and celebrate each other's successes. We believe that modern workplaces succeed by virtue of having high-performance workforces that are diverse in ideas, cultures and experiences. We put in the effort to make such a workplace a daily reality and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

* Surface delivery risks, issues and blockers early; clarify impact, owner, mitigation, decision required and escalation route.
* Track actions and decisions to closure, ensuring that unresolved items are visible and escalated at the right level and time.

**Lead and Improve the Technology Delivery System**
* Provide clear direction, priorities and performance expectations for Delivery Managers and Business Analysts.
* Coach the team in facilitation, planning, analysis, stakeholder management, risk management, communication and constructive challenge.

* Identify recurring friction in governance, decision-making, hand-offs, environments, procurement, resourcing and assurance, and work with accountable leaders to remove it.
* Promote learning through retrospectives, delivery health reviews and the practical reuse of lessons across workstreams.
* Champion inclusive, transparent ways of working that build trust across professional and organisational boundaries.

* Proven people leadership experience, including leading and developing Delivery Managers, Project Managers and/or Business Analysts.
* Strong command of delivery planning, governance, risk and issue management, dependency management, financial awareness and senior-level reporting.
* Demonstrable experience of business analysis and requirements management, including translating ambiguous needs into clear, testable outcomes and acceptance criteria.
* A track record of influencing senior stakeholders, facilitating difficult conversations and securing timely decisions.
* Ability to interpret delivery data, test assumptions and communicate a balanced, candid view of progress and forecast confidence.

# **Staff Product Manager, Product Discovery Engine**
## **About Us**
Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you’ve probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We’re approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We’re a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.
## **Job Summary**
We’re looking for a systems-minded **Staff Product Manager** to take Constructor’s search and discovery to the state of the art — and keep it there — across every retail industry we serve. This is a highly technical, high-leverage role at the core of our **Product Discovery Engine** chapter: the teams responsible for how we retrieve, understand, and rank the right products for every shopper, on every query, for every customer.

# Financial Crime Compliance Generalist, Assistant Vice President
* Full-time
## Company Description
Crown Agents Bank is a vastly growing and regulated UK bank that connects emerging and frontier markets to the rest of the world, using FX and payments technology. We are transforming the way payments and FX move through emerging markets, reducing friction so that more money gets to those who need it. Emerging markets payments are usually challenging, expensive, unreliable and opaque. Our solutions help fix these pain points. Ultimately, we connect traditionally hard-to-reach regions to global financial infrastructure, giving access to the best prices and the fastest, most reliable settlement.
FX and cross-border payments are often complex and expensive, especially when operating in emerging markets. Crown Agents Bank (CAB) wraps its deep and trusted relationships and strength of network around innovative digital capabilities, and cross-border transaction banking solutions to enable fintech, corporates, governments, development organisations and banks to move money to, from, and across often hard-to-reach markets.
## Job Description
**Role Purpose**
This position will play a key role as a generalist member of Crown Agents Bank’s (“CAB”) second-line Financial Crime Compliance (“FCC”) team, supporting the delivery of an effective, well-governed and business-facing FCC framework. The role will contribute across FCC governance, advisory activity, risk oversight, management information, policy standards, international office support and wider team priorities.
The AVP will operate as an experienced FCC generalist and core team player, supporting senior management and colleagues through effective governance forums, high-quality management information, clear policy and procedure standards, and timely, pragmatic and risk-based advice to the business.
The role will require strong capability in the development, management and presentation of FCC management information as part of a broader generalist remit, ensuring that MI is accurate, insightful, well-controlled and capable of supporting effective discussion, escalation and decision-making by senior stakeholders, including the MLRO and relevant governance forums.
The role will require the individual to translate regulatory expectations, internal risk appetite and financial crime typologies into practical guidance, governance outputs and advisory decisions. The individual will support effective challenge, clear escalation, strong audit trails and consistent standards across the FCC control framework, while flexing across wider FCC team priorities as required.
The role will also provide flexible support to the Financial Intelligence Unit (“FIU”) and other FCC colleagues where required, helping to ensure appropriate coordination, information flow and escalation between FCC advisory, governance activity, investigations and business stakeholders.
**Role Responsibilities**
* Support the coordination and continuous improvement of FCC governance forums as part of the wider FCC team, including agenda planning, paper preparation, action tracking and escalation of material matters.
* Develop, manage and present FCC management information as part of a generalist second-line FCC remit, ensuring MI is accurate, insightful, appropriately governed and tailored for senior stakeholders, including the MLRO, committees and other relevant governance forums.
* Provide generalist FCC advisory support to first-line teams and colleagues on AML, sanctions, counter-terrorist financing, anti-bribery and corruption, fraud, client risk, products, payments and higher-risk jurisdictions.
* Provide flexible generalist support to the Financial Intelligence Unit (“FIU”) and wider FCC team where required, including assisting with information collation, governance inputs, escalation tracking and coordination between FIU, FCC advisory and relevant business stakeholders.
* Provide generalist second-line FCC support across CAB’s international offices, helping ensure local activity remains aligned to Group standards, risk appetite, governance expectations and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Support the review and challenge of client risk assessments, enhanced due diligence, periodic reviews, correspondent banking assessments and higher-risk relationship proposals.
* Assist with the development, maintenance and implementation of FCC policies, procedures, standards, guidance notes, templates and advisory frameworks.
* Track financial crime issues, actions, risk acceptances, control enhancements and remediation activity, ensuring clear ownership, timely updates and appropriate escalation.
* Identify themes, trends, emerging risks and control gaps from advisory queries, governance outputs, international office activity, issues, incidents, assurance findings and regulatory developments.
* Support regulatory, audit and assurance activity by providing evidence, drafting responses, coordinating inputs and maintaining clear records of decisions and rationale.
* Promote consistent FCC standards by providing practical guidance, coaching and quality review support to colleagues and business stakeholders.
* Build effective relationships with first-line teams, operations, commercial stakeholders, international office colleagues and senior colleagues, balancing constructive challenge with pragmatic support.
* Support the wider FCC team in delivering governance, advisory, policy, risk assessment, remediation, MI, FIU coordination and control enhancement initiatives.
* Ensure key decisions, advice, approvals, escalations and governance outcomes are clearly documented and capable of audit, assurance or regulatory review.
## Qualifications
* Relevant professional qualification, or working towards one, is desirable, such as ICA, ACAMS, sanctions, compliance, risk or equivalent financial crime certification.
**Experience**
* Minimum 3 to 5 years’ experience in an AML, sanctions, financial crime, compliance, governance, advisory, FIU support or related risk management role, preferably within banking or regulated financial services.
* Strong practical knowledge of UK financial crime requirements, including the Money Laundering Regulations, Proceeds of Crime Act, Terrorism Act, sanctions obligations and relevant JMLSG guidance.
* Experience preparing or supporting governance papers, management information, risk updates, committee materials, policy documents, FIU-related inputs or regulatory/audit responses.
* Experience providing financial crime advisory input on client risk, enhanced due diligence, correspondent banking, payments, products, higher-risk jurisdictions or complex client relationships.
* Experience supporting international offices, branches, subsidiaries or cross-border business activity from a second-line financial crime, compliance or risk perspective is desirable.
* Good understanding of banking products, payments, SWIFT or ISO 20022 messaging, transaction monitoring, screening controls and financial crime control frameworks.
* Experience tracking issues, actions, risk acceptances, control enhancements or remediation activity is desirable.
**Skills**
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex FCC matters clearly and concisely to a range of stakeholders.
* Ability to produce high-quality committee papers, governance updates, advisory notes, risk summaries and management information.
* Sound judgement and ability to make or recommend proportionate, risk-based and well-documented decisions.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and ability to identify themes, risks, issues and control implications from multiple sources of information.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, coordinate inputs, track actions and deliver governance or advisory outputs to deadline.
* Confidence engaging with senior stakeholders and providing constructive challenge in a pragmatic and collaborative manner.
* Ability to operate across jurisdictions and provide generalist second-line support while recognising local regulatory, operational and cultural context.
* Proactive team-focused mindset with a focus on continuous improvement, control enhancement, knowledge sharing, practical problem-solving and supporting wider FCC priorities.

**GLP Vendor Oversight and QA Lead**
The integrity of nonclinical data depends on more than what happens inside a company's walls. Much of the critical work in GLP-regulated research — safety studies, toxicology, analytical testing — is carried out by external laboratories and CROs. When that network of partners operates to the highest quality standards, the science is sound. When it doesn't, the consequences reach all the way to patients.
This role exists to make sure it works.
**Why this role matters**
GLP vendor oversight is often invisible when it's done well — and very visible when it isn't. As the internal authority on GLP and nonclinical vendor quality, you will be the person others turn to when the questions are difficult. If you take data integrity seriously, understand the regulatory landscape deeply, and want to shape how a global company manages its external nonclinical network, this is a role with real scope to make a difference.
**About the role**
Own quality oversight of external partners supporting nonclinical and GLP activities (CROs, laboratories, test facilities). Lead the vendor lifecycle: due diligence, qualification, quality agreements, risk-based monitoring, issue management and continuous improvement, ensuring adherence to GLP/GCP/GMP, data integrity and applicable regulations. Partner with Nonclinical Development, Procurement, Legal and IT.
* **Vendor Lifecycle and Governance:** Run risk-based qualification and requalification, draft and maintain Quality Agreements, and set vendor KPIs and governance forums, ensuring actions and CAPAs are closed.
* **Inspections**: Identify and prioritise vendors for audit on a risk basis; planning, conducting and grading sits with the audit function. Confirm vendor CAPAs are fit for purpose and run effectiveness checks. Coordinate inspection readiness and front- and back-room support.
* **Quality Systems and Compliance:** Ensure vendor practices meet GLP/GCP/GMP, OECD GLP, 21 CFR Part 58, ICH, ISO and data integrity (ALCOA+). Provide input on third-party deviations, change control, CAPA, and the QMS.
* **Risk Management and Continuous Improvement:** Lead vendor risk assessments (risk registers, FMEA) to set oversight frequency, improve vendor performance, and present trends at management reviews.
* **Cross-Functional Partnership**: Embed quality requirements in scopes of work and contracts, guide technology transfers and data flows, and train internal stakeholders.
* **Maintain and share knowledge of Regulations and Requirements:** Stay current with GLP and GxP regulations and translate changes into CSL requirements.
**Position Qualifications and Experience Requirements:**
**Education:** Bachelor's degree in a relevant scientific discipline.
**Experience**: 3+ years of GxP quality experience with direct vendor/CRO oversight and/or auditing (GLP/GCP/GMP), nonclinical/GLP preferred. Knowledge of OECD GLP, 21 CFR Part 58, Annex 11/Part 11 and data integrity (ALCOA+). Strong communication and negotiation skills.
**Competencies**: Works with limited supervision across multinational teams. Strong analytical, problem-solving, influencing and organisational skills. Knowledge of QMS implementation, regulatory frameworks and audit/inspection management.

Build the multi-agent reasoning systems that plan, hypothesize, and validate attack paths autonomously.

* Build evaluation harnesses that measure agent accuracy against known-ground-truth environments.
* Improve agent-to-agent coordination and shared memory across the swarm.
* Reduce false-positive rate by tightening the confidence-scoring and validation handoff logic.

* 3+ years building production ML or LLM-backed systems.

* **Drive Enterprise API Adoption:** You will own the features that turn enterprise interest into deep, durable adoption. Examples include usage insights, cost and consumption controls, and the governance tooling that lets large organizations understand and manage how they use DeepL's APIs
* **Build for Governance & Compliance:** You will design the controls enterprise IT and security admins rely on (roles and permissions, projects, data residency, and audit-ability), making DeepL the compliant default for regulated, global organizations
* **Guardianship of Quality & Production Reliability:** You will own your services end-to-end, including participation in the API on-call rotation, with a shared goal of taking our public API to four nines of reliability. * **Architect Across the Enterprise Ecosystem:** You will work deep within DeepL's existing technical and organizational structures, navigating dependencies across different areas and many stakeholder teams to ship cohesive, reliable enterprise capabilities
## **Qualities we look for**
* **An "Enterprise-First" Mindset:** You treat enterprise IT and security admins as your primary users. You understand that earning their trust means clear governance, predictable cost control, robust compliance, fast response times and data residency. You're a strong communicator who's comfortable owning product decisions and implementing them
* **Backend Mastery at Scale (C# / .NET):** You have deep expertise designing scalable backend systems, RESTful APIs, and distributed architectures, primarily in C# / .NET, and you've worked with high-scale distributed systems in production. * **Enterprise Platform Fluency:** You bring hands-on experience with the building blocks of modern enterprise APIs (MCP, CLIs, and OAuth) and know how to wield them to build secure, extensible integrations
* **Cross-Team Leadership:** You have a track record of leading projects across multiple teams. You can align with different areas and other stakeholders, manage cross-team contracts and dependencies, and keep complex, interconnected systems coherent
* **Extreme Ownership & Operational Excellence:** You own your services end-to-end (production operations, incident response, and on-call) and you're motivated by pushing reliability toward four nines. You write comprehensive tests, learn from incidents, and treat mature SLOs as a core engineering feature
* **AI-Native Velocity:** You leverage AI-powered tools (like Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery so you can focus your energy on high-value architecture and complex problem-solving
* **Bonus points if you have:** a track record of zero-downtime migrations on live systems; experience with metering, quota, or usage-data systems; worked in a compliance environment (SOC 2, ISO 27001, C5, or similar)

Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

* **Hybrid work, flexible hours**: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
* **Virtual Shares:** An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
* **Regular in-person team events**: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
* **Monthly full-day hacking sessions**: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
* **30 days of annual leave**: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
* **Competitive benefits**: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.
If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

**Lead our shift from AI-assisted coding to AI-led delivery**
* Own the trajectory: take us from engineers using assistants to help write code, to engineers directing agents that write it — with the human firmly in the loop as architect, reviewer and accountable owner rather than as the typist.

* Move us beyond individual developer habits to engineering discipline that holds at organisational scale — and at the change volume that agentic delivery produces.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

You will own a book of customers outright: onboarding them, keeping them engaged with their data, and getting them to renewal in better shape than they started. The role is built around the conversations our telematics makes possible, from quarterly reviews with fleet managers to safety interventions that follow a spike in risky driving, alongside a steady variety of inbound queries by phone and email. * Clear written and spoken communication, with a knack for making complex things easy to understand, and the confidence to present to clients

* **SLA and KPI Performance:** Monitor SLA performance, ticket hygiene, response quality, resolution quality and operational KPIs, taking corrective action where performance is at risk.
* **ITIL Process Discipline:** Ensure the pod follows ITIL-aligned processes for incident, request, problem, change and escalation management, adapting day-to-day ways of working where needed.
* **Team Performance and Development:** Support, mentor and develop 1st and 2nd line staff, encouraging accountability, collaboration and high standards of ticket ownership.

This is not monitoring from a distance. At Fortrea Clinical Pharmacology Services in Leeds, CRAs are on site, in the flow of the study, when it matters most.
You see dosing days . You walk the clinic floor. You review data as it is generated, not months later. It is a different way to work as a CRA.
It all happens inside a world-class 100-bed, 65,000 ft2 Clinical Research Unit, only 7 minutes from the train station, where life‐saving medicines begin their journey.

* **Full‐time**, **permanent** job.

Involved in studies even before they are won (i.e., participating at BID meetings), you will:
**Be on-site for the moments sponsors travel the world to witness**.
This includes first-in-human dosing days, when you review eligibility, observe dosing and safety procedures in real time, and see decisions unfold as the study begins.
You will also follow PK samples into the lab, and work side by side with clinic, pharmacy, and lab teams during the most critical moments of the study.
**Rarely work alone.**

The Leeds Clinical Research Unit gives you the option to work from the office, collaborate face to face, and build real working relationships with CRAs, CTLs, and clinical teams. You will be part of a global team, closely interacting with our other US Clinics/CRAs.

Description
The Senior Database Engineer carries the pivotal responsibility of engineering, overseeing, and preserving the integrity, scalability, and performance of the company's complex relational open source database systems. This multifaceted role encompasses high-availability infrastructure management, replication tuning, robust backup and recovery procedures, precise performance optimization, capacity planning, proactive monitoring, and infrastructure automation using modern Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tooling.
As a Senior Database Engineer, you will play an integral role in driving the reliability, resilience, and automation of our data infrastructure. You will champion automated configuration and deployment workflows via Ansible and/or Terraform, ensuring our database ecosystems scale seamlessly while delivering high-quality, ultra-low-latency services to our applications, clients, and internal stakeholders.
This role stands as a keystone in our technology landscape, requiring a blend of deep technical expertise, engineering foresight, proactive problem-solving, and diligent documentation practices to maintain the health and vitality of our data tier.
Key Responsibilities
High Availability & Architecture: Construct, evolve, and uphold PostgreSQL (on-prem and RDS) and MySQL systems characterized by high availability, fault tolerance, and security, tailored to the specific performance requirements of latency-sensitive applications.
Automation & Infrastructure as Code: Design, implement, and maintain database provisioning, configuration management, and deployment pipelines using Ansible and/or Terraform.
Replication & Data Synchronization: Configure, manage, and troubleshoot multi-region and multi-node database replication strategies across both PostgreSQL (e.g., streaming replication, logical replication) and MySQL ecosystems.
Performance Tuning & Optimization: Mitigate database downtime while continuously optimizing query execution, indexes, engine parameters, and schema designs for swift response times.
Backup, Disaster Recovery & Security: Utilize high-speed transaction recovery methods, execute routine disaster recovery simulations, and enforce robust data backup, encryption, and privacy standards.
Monitoring & Capacity Planning: Vigilantly monitor system health and database performance metrics, anticipate growth trends through capacity planning, and apply maintenance updates, security patches, and engine upgrades as required.
Standards & Documentation: Establish, enforce, and meticulously document database policies, operational standards, schema designs, and runbooks.
Knowledge Sharing & Leadership: Facilitate the transfer of knowledge within the team, mentor junior and mid-level engineers, and foster collective engineering excellence.
Production Support: Offer Tier 3 support for critical production systems, actively participating in a 24x7 on-call rotation schedule when necessary.
Requirements
Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience as a Database Engineer or Database Administrator in production environments (experience in high-throughput industries such as i-gaming, fintech, or e-commerce is highly preferred).
Dual-Engine Expertise: Deep proficiency in both PostgreSQL and MySQL open-source database engines, including internal architectures, engine-specific parameter tuning, and troubleshooting.
Automation & IaC: Proven practical experience using Ansible for configuration management/orchestration and Terraform for infrastructure provisioning.
Database High Availability: Hands-on experience with HA solutions such as Patroni, PgBouncer, Galera Cluster, or MySQL InnoDB Cluster/Group Replication.
Low-Latency & High-Volume: Track record of managing latency-sensitive, high-concurrency database deployments.
Backup & Recovery: Comprehensive expertise in point-in-time recovery (PITR), logical/physical backups, security hardening, and data integrity checks.
Scripting & Tooling: Strong proficiency in Bash/Shell/Python scripting, and working with frontend/backend DBA tools and monitoring suites.

# Staff Backend Engineer - Grafana Second Horizon | Ireland | Remote
Republic of Ireland (Remote)
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
**This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.**
#### The Opportunity:
At Grafana Labs, we build observability tools that help users understand, respond to, and improve their systems – regardless of scale, complexity, or tech stack. We recently started a skunkworks initiative with a mission to bring observability to the rest of the business. Our goal is to make Grafana the single best place where humans and AI agents understand and act on real-time data from across the enterprise. As part of this initiative, we are building an AI-native data intelligence system that gives agents reliable, governed access to enterprise context. This system helps agents retrieve the right data, metadata, definitions, lineage, quality signals, and institutional knowledge without every agent builder having to maintain their own brittle context files. The principle is simple: the context system retrieves, agents decide, and data teams maintain the intelligence.
The new team is a mix of seasoned Grafanistas and new hires. We operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, both as individuals and as a team. Engineers are empowered to make decisions, move quickly, and validate ideas early – while being supported by a deeply collaborative culture that values curiosity, feedback, and cross-functional partnership.
We’re looking for a Staff-level Backend Engineer to help build the first production services for this context layer management system. You will design and ship the core backend architecture that powers ingestion, context storage, retrieval APIs, and agent-facing integrations. This is an early-stage role on a high-autonomy team, so you should be comfortable working through ambiguity, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and building systems that can evolve from internal dogfooding to production-grade SaaS. As the team matures, there’s a broad opportunity to expand or redefine this role based on impact and initiative.
#### What You'll Be Doing:
* Build the core backend services: Design, implement, test, and operate the first services for context ingestion, context indexing, retrieval orchestration, API access, source configuration, and system administration.
* Create a scalable SaaS foundation: Help define and build the architecture for a multi-tenant service, including tenant isolation, usage tracking, quotas, audit logs, background jobs, and reliable service boundaries.
* Power agent-facing retrieval workflows: Build APIs and service interfaces that allow AI agents, MCP tools, CLIs, and internal applications to retrieve relevant context, provenance, confidence signals, and warnings.
* Work across product and infrastructure: Partner with the team to make practical tradeoffs between fast experimentation and long-term reliability, especially as the project moves from prototype to production.
* Operate what you build: Instrument services with metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and dashboards. Use observability tools to understand system behavior and improve reliability.
* Contribute to technical direction: Help shape the architecture, service boundaries, storage choices, API contracts, deployment patterns, and engineering practices for a new product area.
* Effective communication: You’ll be working in a highly dynamic and collaborative environment, so we need someone who can communicate effectively and contribute across teams.
* Ownership and impact: Take full ownership of the AI solutions you develop, ensuring they are not only innovative but also scalable, maintainable, and aligned with real user workflows.
#### What Makes You a Great Fit:
* Strong engineering skills: Solid experience building production-grade, user-facing software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems and making UI design decisions with minimal supervision.
* AI experience with a practical mindset: You’re familiar with AI technologies and frameworks, and you focus on delivering high-quality solutions that work in the real world, not just in theory.
* Quick iteration and experimentation: You’re comfortable releasing prototypes, collecting feedback, and iterating with a pragmatic mindset.
* Proven initiative: You take ownership and drive projects forward, pushing boundaries to find the most impactful solutions. You can deal with ambiguity and are able to define scope where things are loosely defined.
* Collaborative attitude: You communicate effectively with your peers. You’re open to feedback, and you bring a solutions-oriented mindset to the table.

* Proven track record of delivering software that made it into production and is actively used by users.

* Experience using observability tools to understand and troubleshoot system behavior.

* Experience building tools for data engineering.

We are a remote-first team that meets regularly over video and does most of our work asynchronously, in writing. We value creativity, diverse perspectives, and clear communication. Tempo is relied upon by prominent global organizations to monitor critical applications and infrastructure, and we expect everyone on the team, including our Staff engineers, to contribute ideas that make it a more reliable, more useful, and more loved product.

At Greyparrot, we are on a mission to solve the global waste crisis by introducing transparency and automation to a traditionally opaque sector. As the pioneer of AI-powered waste intelligence, our technology processes billions of waste objects, turning waste into actionable data.
Through our hardware-enabled SaaS model, including the Greyparrot Analyzer, which uses computer vision above recycling conveyor belts, and Deepnest, our packaging intelligence platform, we help recycling facilities, consumer goods businesses and regulators understand packaging performance, improve recovery and make better operational and commercial decisions.
About the Role
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Product Manager to help us mature and improve our established product ecosystem. This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys being close to customers, working through detail with designers and engineers, and taking ownership from early discovery through delivery, adoption and continuous improvement.
Our Product team is small. You will work directly with our Product Designer and partner closely with Engineering, AI, Commercial and Customer teams. You will bring structure and momentum to the day-to-day product process while remaining comfortable doing the practical work yourself, from customer interviews and problem definition to writing clear requirements, testing solutions and reviewing results after launch.
The product is already in market, so the focus is on understanding where it can work better, strengthening the customer experience and improving how our software, data and physical systems work together in live production environments. You will contribute to the roadmap within the product direction set by our leadership, rather than being expected to define company-wide product strategy or build a new function from scratch.
This role will be based in our London office at least one day a week and reports directly to Ambrish, our Cofounder and Exec Team.
Key Responsibilities
Own the product lifecycle: Manage work from discovery and validation through prioritisation, delivery, launch, adoption and iteration. Make sure we learn from what we release and use those insights to improve the product.
Mature the existing product: Identify opportunities to improve usability, onboarding, reliability, customer value and operational efficiency across products already used in live customer environments.
Stay close to customers: Spend time with recycling operators, enterprise customers and internal teams to understand real workflows, pain points and priorities. Turn what you learn into clear product problems and measurable outcomes.
Shape and manage the roadmap: Work with cross-functional leaders to translate product direction into a focused, realistic roadmap. Balance customer needs, commercial priorities, technical dependencies and longer-term product health.
Define clear product work: Write practical requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria. Partner closely with our Product Designer to test assumptions and ensure proposed solutions are useful, usable and ready for Engineering.
Partner with Engineering: Work day to day with technical teams to understand constraints, make sensible trade-offs and keep delivery moving. Be comfortable discussing data quality, system dependencies and the realities of software connected to hardware.
Support delivery and launch: Maintain clarity on scope, decisions and progress throughout development. Coordinate with Commercial and Customer teams so releases are understood, introduced well and supported by the right product knowledge.
Measure product performance: Define practical success measures and use product data, customer feedback and operational insight to assess adoption, retention and value. Use evidence to recommend what should change next.
Strengthen product ways of working: Help a small team establish lightweight, repeatable practices for discovery, prioritisation, decision-making and delivery without adding unnecessary process.

Extensive commercial product management experience, with strong evidence of personally owning products through the full lifecycle.
Experience improving and maturing an established product after launch, including using customer feedback and product data to guide prioritisation and iteration.
A hands-on approach and experience working effectively in a small or lean Product team, where you have personally carried out discovery, written requirements and supported delivery.
Experience with B2B software or data products. Experience in industrial, manufacturing, recycling, logistics or another physical production environment would be particularly valuable.
A practical understanding of how software interacts with hardware, operational workflows and real-world constraints. Experience with hardware-enabled SaaS, IoT or data products is helpful.
Strong product discovery skills, including customer interviews, problem definition, hypothesis testing and translating insight into focused product work.
Sound technical judgement and the ability to work confidently with Engineering, Data and AI teams. You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be able to understand dependencies, ask good questions and make clear trade-offs.
A record of balancing customer needs, commercial priorities and technical constraints while keeping delivery focused and achievable.
Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to bring structure to complex discussions and keep teams aligned on decisions, scope and outcomes.
Comfort working directly with customers and visiting operational sites to understand how products are used in practice.
How you will work
You are curious, practical and comfortable moving between customer conversations, product detail and delivery decisions.
You bring enough structure to help a small team work well, while keeping processes proportionate to the problem.
You take ownership, communicate early and value progress supported by evidence over perfect plans.
You enjoy collaborating closely with people from different disciplines and are happy to get into the detail when the work requires it.

# Training Facilitator
## About the role
The Training Facilitator is a field-based role within the Quality and Governance Directorate, responsible for delivering mandatory and practice development training to care and support staff across a designated group of HC-One homes. Reporting to the Head of Training and Practice Development, the postholder plays a vital role in ensuring that every member of staff across their allocated homes has the knowledge, skills, and competence to deliver safe, high-quality, and person-centred care — and that all mandatory training obligations are met consistently and on time. This is a practical, people-focused role for an experienced care professional who is passionate about sharing their knowledge, developing others, and making a direct contribution to the quality of care that residents receive. The Training Facilitator delivers training in homes across their area using a mix of face-to-face classroom sessions, practical skills demonstrations, and on-the-job coaching, working closely with Home Managers to ensure training is relevant, well-attended, and embedded in day-to-day practice. Main Activities Duties and Responsibilities Mandatory and Statutory Training Delivery • Deliver the full range of mandatory and statutory training to care and support staff across allocated homes, in line with the Group’s mandatory training framework and the requirements of CQC (England), CIW (Wales), and Care Inspectorate (Scotland) as applicable. • Deliver training across all mandatory topics including — but not limited to — moving and handling, fire safety, safeguarding adults, infection prevention and control, health and safety, food hygiene, medication awareness, basic life support, and DoLS/MCA awareness, using HC-One’s approved materials and session plans. • Ensure training sessions are well-planned, well-resourced, and delivered to a consistently high standard, adapting style and approach to meet the learning needs of a diverse adult care workforce including staff for whom English is not a first language. • Maintain accurate attendance and completion records for all training sessions delivered, ensuring records are promptly entered into the Group’s learning management system (LMS) and that Home Managers have visibility of their team’s training compliance status. • Monitor mandatory training compliance within allocated homes, proactively identifying gaps, working with Home Managers to schedule outstanding training, and escalating persistent non-compliance to the Head of Training and Practice Development. Practice Development and Skills Training • Deliver targeted practice development training within homes in response to needs identified by the Head of Training and Practice Development, Quality Improvement Leads, quality colleagues or Home Managers, covering clinical and care topics including care planning, pressure care and wound management, nutrition and hydration, dementia awareness, end of life care, falls prevention, and continence care. • Deliver practical skills sessions within homes, including moving and handling competency assessments, basic life support refreshers, and other skills-based programmes that require hands-on demonstration and supervised practice rather than classroom learning alone. • Support the completion and review of role-specific competency assessments, working with Home Managers and senior colleagues to ensure staff are observed in practice, assessed against agreed standards, and provided with clear feedback and follow-up support where further development is required. • Provide on-the-job coaching to care staff during home visits where training needs or practice concerns have been identified, working alongside individuals to demonstrate correct technique, give constructive feedback, and build confidence and competence in a supportive way. • Support the induction of new starters within allocated homes, delivering elements of the Group-wide induction programme and working with Home Managers to ensure new employees receive a warm, well-structured, and compliant introduction to their role and to HC-One’s values and care standards. HC-One Job Description V2.0
Training Needs Identification and Home Support • Build effective working relationships with Home Managers across allocated homes, developing a good understanding of each home’s team, training history, and current practice development priorities. • Work with Home Managers to identify training needs within their teams, including gaps highlighted by supervision, competency assessments, incident reviews, complaints, or feedback from Quality Improvement Leads, and plan training activity accordingly. • Provide Home Managers with practical guidance on how to identify and address training needs within their teams between formal training sessions, supporting them to build a culture of continuous learning and development within the home. • Attend or contribute to team meetings, supervisions, and practice development discussions within homes where this would support the embedding of learning or the identification of emerging training priorities. Training Delivery Quality and Evaluation • Collect and review delegate feedback after every training session, using evaluation data to continuously improve delivery approach, session content, and the learning experience for participants. • Assess delegate learning at the end of training sessions where required, using knowledge checks, skills assessments, or competency observations to confirm that learning objectives have been met and that any individuals requiring additional support are identified and followed up. • Conduct follow-up observations of practice in homes after training sessions where appropriate, checking that learning has been transferred into day-to-day working practice and that improvements are being sustained. • Report evaluation findings, attendance data, and any concerns about training uptake or practice embedding to the Head of Training and Practice Development, contributing to the team’s continuous improvement of the training programme. Training Materials and Resource Management • Use HC-One’s approved training materials, session plans, and resources consistently and accurately, maintaining the integrity and quality of the Group’s training programmes across all homes in the designated area. • Keep training equipment — including moving and handling aids, first aid manikins, and other practical training resources — in good working order, reporting any defects or replacement needs to the Head of Training and Practice Development promptly. • Suggest improvements to training materials, session plans, or resources based on practical delivery experience, sharing feedback with the Head of Training and Practice Development to support continuous improvement of the curriculum. • Stay current with changes to mandatory training requirements, clinical best practice, regulatory guidance, and sector developments relevant to the training topics delivered, seeking support and update training from the Head of Training and Practice Development as needed.E-Learning and Blended Learning Support • Support staff within allocated homes to access and complete mandatory e-learning modules through the Group’s learning management system, providing practical assistance to employees who are less confident with technology and ensuring e-learning completion is integrated with face-to-face training activity. • Work with Home Managers to ensure e-learning is embedded within rotas and working patterns, so that online training is treated as a scheduled and priority activity rather than an ad hoc addition to the working day. • Liaise with the Head of Training and Practice Development regarding any technical issues affecting elearning access or completion within allocated homes, ensuring these are escalated and resolved promptly to prevent gaps in compliance. Reporting & Team Contribution • Provide regular updates to the Head of Training and Practice Development on training delivery activity, mandatory compliance status, and any emerging training needs or concerns across allocated homes. • Contribute actively to Training team meetings, sharing delivery experiences, raising questions about training content or approach, and supporting a collaborative and reflective team culture. • Support colleagues within the Training Facilitator team where needed, including covering training sessions in other areas during periods of absence and sharing materials or approaches that have worked well in their own delivery.

#### **About the role**
The PMO IT Lead is responsible for establishing and leading the IT Programme Management Office (PMO) for a large-scale business and technology transformation programme Atlas. The role ensures effective governance, planning, reporting, financial control, resource management, risk management, dependencies management and delivery assurance support across multiple workstreams and projects.
The PMO IT Lead acts as the central point of coordination between IT stakeholders, programme leadership, IT project managers, workstream leads, technology teams, vendors, business Leads and governance forums to ensure successful delivery of the programme. This role will work closely with the Transformation Office PMO and existing IT PMO.
