* Establish and maintain programme governance frameworks, standards, and controls.
* Supports and helps facilitate steering committees, programme boards, stage gate reviews, and executive governance forums.
* Ensure compliance with organisational delivery methodologies and governance requirements.
* Maintain programme documentation, decision logs, and audit readiness.
**Planning, Integration & Delivery Control**
* Maintain the integrated master plan across all projects in Atlas, workstreams, suppliers and business activities for IT.
* Define programme planning standards, assumptions, baselines, milestones and reporting cycles with the Transformation PMO.
* Assure the quality and completeness of project plans before incorporation into the integrated master plan.
* Identify and manage critical paths, cross-project milestones, schedule conflicts and business-to-technology integration points.
* Assess the programme-wide impact of proposed scope, schedule, resource or solution changes before approval.
* Track performance against approved scope, schedule and cost baselines, challenging unsupported forecasts and recovery assumptions.
**Planning & Delivery Management**
* Own and maintain integrated programme plans across all workstreams.
* Monitor milestones, dependencies, critical paths, and delivery timelines.
* Track programme performance against approved baselines.
* Ensure alignment between business and technology delivery schedules.

* Provide clear visibility of programme health through KPI, milestone, financial, and RAG reporting.
* Deliver concise management information to senior stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Drive data-driven decision making through programme analytics.

* Ensure timely escalation and resolution of critical risks and issues.
* Facilitate mitigation planning and dependency management across workstreams.
* Maintain programme risk registers and action tracking.

* Track financial performance and variance analysis.
* Maintain benefits realisation plans and reporting.
* Work closely with Finance teams to ensure effective financial governance.

## Job Description
At IFS, we’re building the next generation of AI-native enterprise software. We’re looking for a Principal Platform Engineer to build the shared authentication and authorisation capabilities that our product engineering teams depend on.
**You should be a hands-on platform engineer who builds through code and automates by default.** Your experience might centre on infrastructure as code, deployment pipelines, automation, platform tooling or service integrations. What matters is that you have built reliable, repeatable capabilities that engineering teams use to deliver and operate software.
Your background may be in platform engineering, infrastructure, SRE, identity engineering or systems integration. What matters is substantial hands-on experience building or extending platform capabilities through code and automation, supporting the delivery and operation of software.
A software development background is particularly valuable, but it is not a prerequisite. We welcome engineers whose coding experience has developed through platform engineering, infrastructure or SRE work.
**Architecture, administration and product configuration alone are not sufficient.** We want to understand what you personally implemented, tested, automated and supported in production.
We’re interested in what you have personally built and automated: how you provisioned it, tested changes, delivered it safely and enabled other teams to use it without depending on manual intervention. Identity and access is the domain you will work in; specialist experience in that domain is particularly welcome.
This is an opportunity to shape a critical platform capability, with substantial technical ownership and impact across our engineering organisation.
**The job**
We are hiring two Principal Platform Engineers to help unify authentication and authorisation across our next-generation enterprise software platform.
We are consolidating a fragmented authorisation landscape into one model across three hosting environments: our cloud-native platform, our legacy hosting platform and our lifecycle cloud. It must be correct, fast and reliable in distributed, multi-tenant environments.
Our current stack includes SpiceDB backed by PostgreSQL for authorisation, and Curity for authentication, with Keycloak estates migrating onto it. These describe the systems you will work on; prior experience with every product is not required.
You will design and build platform services, APIs and automation, own them in production, and establish patterns that product engineering teams can adopt confidently. A central part of the role is making secure authentication and authorisation available through documented, automated, self-service workflows.
This is a hands-on role. You will write and review infrastructure and automation code, build platform integrations, and contribute to tooling and services, including those written in Go.
**What we need to see**
**Platform engineering and automation**
* Software platforms or shared services you have built and operated for application engineering teams.
* Infrastructure code, automation, delivery pipelines, integrations or platform tooling you have personally built and maintained.
* Automation covering provisioning, configuration, deployment, upgrades and recovery, managed through version control and repeatable delivery pipelines.
* Self-service capabilities that reduce manual intervention and enable developers to work independently.
* Experience deploying and operating containerised application services on Kubernetes in a software delivery environment.
**Authorisation**
* Practical understanding of access control within applications and APIs, including role-based, attribute-based and relationship-based models.
* Experience implementing permission checks or designing permission models, with an understanding of tenant isolation and security boundaries.
* The ability to reason about correctness, latency, consistency and the traceability of authorisation decisions.
* Familiarity with fine-grained authorisation engines or policy-as-code approaches is valuable.
**Authentication**
* Practical understanding of authentication for software applications and services, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and token lifecycle management.
* Experience implementing or extending authentication flows in software, with an understanding of validation, trust boundaries and failure modes.
* Understanding of enterprise federation, SSO and external identity-provider integration in a customer-facing platform.
* Deeper experience engineering and operating authentication infrastructure at scale is particularly welcome.
**Production ownership**
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, containers, GitOps and Infrastructure as Code.
* An approach to reliability that includes observability, performance testing, safe rollouts, rollback, backup and recovery.
* Examples of diagnosing production failures and using code or automation to prevent recurrence.
* Sound engineering judgement across distributed systems, relational data and event-driven services.
**How we work**
You will remain close to the code while helping other engineers make good architectural decisions. We value clear technical reasoning, constructive challenge and ownership from design through production.
We are interested in how AI-assisted engineering fits into your work: what you delegate, how you review and test the results, and how you remain accountable for the software you ship.
## Qualifications
**Must have — platform engineering**
* Substantial hands-on experience building and operating platforms or shared infrastructure that support software engineering teams.
* Strong coding and scripting skills applied to infrastructure, automation, deployment tooling or integrations. You should be comfortable maintaining code, reviewing changes and using automated tests.
* Experience automating provisioning, configuration, deployment and operational tasks through version-controlled, repeatable workflows.
* Production experience with Kubernetes and containers in an environment delivering and operating software applications.
* Practical experience with a major public cloud platform, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD and GitOps.
* Experience building reusable platform capabilities or self-service workflows that reduce manual work for engineering teams.
* Sound understanding of APIs, networking, data stores and distributed-system behaviour, with the ability to troubleshoot production issues.
* Evidence of technical leadership through design decisions, code reviews, engineering standards and support for other engineers.
Experience developing application or backend services is a strong advantage, but is not required. Your coding experience may come primarily from infrastructure and platform engineering. You should be willing to work with our Go-based tooling and services and develop your capabilities where needed.
**Must have — authentication and authorisation foundations**
* Practical experience implementing authentication and access control within software applications, APIs or shared platform services.
* Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and token-based authentication, including secure validation and common failure modes.
* Understanding of permission models, least privilege and tenant isolation, and the ability to explain where access decisions are enforced.
* The ability to translate security requirements into working software, automated tests and maintainable platform capabilities.
**We would particularly like to talk to you if...**
* You have production experience with **Curity**, especially extending it, automating its configuration and lifecycle, or operating it as part of a software platform.
* You have engineered and operated **Keycloak** in a software product environment, including customisation, automated delivery or migrations.
* You have built fine-grained authorisation using **SpiceDB** or a comparable relationship-based authorisation engine.
* You have deeper experience with enterprise federation, SAML, policy-as-code or authentication and authorisation in distributed, multi-tenant systems.
* You have built self-service identity capabilities, APIs or SDKs that other engineering teams use.
* You have worked with Go, PostgreSQL and Kafka or RedPanda in production.
These are advantages, not substitutes for strong platform engineering, coding and automation skills. Strong platform engineers with relevant authentication and authorisation foundations are encouraged to apply even if they have not used our specific products.

Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

at innocent drinks
* London, United Kingdom
* Full Time
* Posted 2 days ago
Here at innocent, we’re on a mission to make it easier for everyone to get more fruit and veg into their bodies. We started back in 1999 and since then we’ve gone from selling a few smoothies at a music festival to becoming one of Europe’s biggest drinks companies with around 1,000 people (and the B Corp seal of approval).
It’s nice to be able to say things like that but we’re not patting ourselves on the back just yet. We want to show everyone that it’s possible to be a successful business while looking after people and the planet too, so we’re trying to get better in pretty much every way. And that’s where this job comes in.
Our business has changed a lot, and the projects ahead of us are not the neat, straightforward kind.
As we grow, the new and evolving capabilities we need bring together people from across innocent and are delivered through a mix of process, technology and data. This role puts you in the driving seat of making that change happen.
We're looking for a Senior Transformation Project Manager to lead some of our highest-profile and most business-critical projects across Enterprise Services. You'll help transform our business by tackling complex challenges, bringing the right people together and leading change all the way through to delivery.
You'll also help raise the bar for project management at innocent. Alongside delivering brilliant work yourself, you'll help define what great looks like and support others to get there too. You won't have direct reports, but you'll play an important role in mentoring, coaching and developing project management capability across the business.
You'll be * Leading our most complex and high-profile business and technology transformation projects from early idea through to successful delivery.
* Turning broad and ambiguous business needs into clear project scope, outcomes, plans and ways of working.
* Bringing temporary, cross-functional teams together and helping everyone understand their role in the bigger picture.
* Setting up effective governance, reporting, tools and project controls without needing a ready-made blueprint.
* Working with senior sponsors and subject matter experts to move decisions forward, even when information is incomplete.
* Selecting, mobilising and managing external delivery partners, holding them to high standards throughout.
* Connecting business needs with partner and technology expertise, making the complicated easier to understand.
* Strengthening project management capability across innocent through mentoring, coaching and leading by example.
You'll have * A strong track record of leading large-scale, cross-functional transformation from definition through to delivery.
* Excellent project management fundamentals, including planning, governance, reporting, risk management and delivery control.
* The critical thinking to connect complex information, challenge assumptions and create clarity from ambiguity.
* The tenacity to move decisions, budgets and dependencies forward while balancing pace, quality and outcomes.
* Confidence influencing senior sponsors, project teams and external partners without relying on formal authority.
* Experience working in a fast-paced, visible and outcomes-focused environment, with the judgement to adapt your approach to each project.
You'll get * The opportunity to lead some of innocent's highest-profile and most business-critical transformation projects.
* Challenging work involving new capabilities, applications, partners, integrations and ways of working.
* The chance to shape projects from the beginning, rather than inheriting a finished brief and simply following the plan.
* Broad exposure across innocent, connecting Technology with teams and expertise from right across the business.
* The opportunity to work closely with senior sponsors, specialist partners and talented cross-functional teams.
* A genuine voice in defining what brilliant project delivery looks like and helping our project management community continue to grow.
We want innocent to be a great place to work, so we do lots of stuff to make people feel at home and try to make sure everyone’s career is shaping up the way they want it to. There are plenty of opportunities to have a go at something new or take things further.
In exchange for helping us do business in the right way, you’ll get a solid rewards package that includes a salary (phew), private healthcare, a target-based bonus, and a bunch of other nice things like a day off on your birthday. And yes, you get free smoothies.
We also know that not all our drinkers come from the same background, or think the same – so why should we? At innocent, we want to be a great place to work where a diverse bunch of people from all backgrounds can turn up and thrive. When we hire, we want all the juice, bits, and pulp that make you who you are.
Even if you don’t think you can tick all the boxes, if the job sounds right for you, come and throw your hat in the ring.
Probably best to get your skates on though, as we might close this early if we get loads of applications.

# Partnerships Manager - Integrations, Channels and Plugins
## At InPost we hire awesome people who aren’t afraid to bring ideas to the table, to make mistakes, and challenge the norm!
We usually respond within three days
Want to be part of a UK hub, in a global business that is scaling rapidly, evolving fast and radically changing the decades-old delivery universe? If so, read on, as we’re looking for a P**artnerships Manager - Integrations, Channels and Plugins ­­­­** to join our **Commercial** team!
Our mission? To switch up the status quo and become the UK’s leading out-of-home business. With a fast-growing network of thousands of smart lockers, hundreds of leading retail partners and the launch of our transformative Send service, we’re bringing freedom to anyone with a parcel.
At InPost UK, we’re building an unparalleled group of talent that’s committed to help us power our mission to reshape the way parcels move, and redefine eCommerce logistics. Our team is packed full of top-notch experts in e-commerce, technology, scale-up growth, sustainability, logistics and supply chain. We’re a passionate bunch with high ambition – we collaborate, innovate, support each other, and leave egos at the door.
**About the role:**
InPost is looking for a Partnership Manager to own and grow our relationships with the platforms that bring merchants to us indirectly — third-party integration providers (such as Metapack, Scurri and nShift), returns and channel platforms (such as ZigZag), and ecommerce plugin and app marketplace partners (such as Shopify, WooCommerce and Magento).
You'll be InPost's commercial and brand custodian across these channels: making InPost the natural first choice within every partner ecosystem, embedding our proposition into partner sales conversations and product configurations, and driving volume growth through partner-led activity rather than direct merchant acquisition.
**What you’ll be doing:**
* Own the day-to-day and strategic relationship with InPost's key integration, channel and plugin partners, acting as their primary point of contact within InPost.
* Build trusted relationships across partner success, commercial, technical and product teams to secure wide visibility and active advocacy for InPost.
* Develop and maintain account plans for each partner, with joint commercial objectives, engagement cadences and co-marketing activity, reviewed through MBRs and QBRs.
* Act as InPost's brand custodian, ensuring our services are represented accurately and compellingly across partner products, documentation and merchant-facing materials.
* Drive commercial activation of each channel, working with partner sales and success teams to get InPost actively recommended to merchants.
* Build and deliver partner enablement programmes, equipping partner teams to position InPost's out-of-home delivery proposition with confidence.
* Identify upsell and channel expansion opportunities, and negotiate commercial agreements and co-marketing arrangements within InPost's frameworks.
* Track and report on volume and revenue contribution by channel, holding partners accountable to agreed growth targets.
* Work with Product and technical teams to keep integrations sound and up to date, and feed partner and merchant feedback into the product roadmap.
* Maintain accurate CRM records and provide regular reporting on channel contribution, partner health and growth opportunities.
**What we need from you:**
We’re looking for people who are ready for a fast paced environment, get their kicks out of problem solving and can balance getting today's stuff done, whilst building for the future. We’re looking for people with drive and natural curiosity – who want to do things differently. And do them brilliantly.
* Experience in partner management, channel partnerships or B2B relationship management, owning commercial relationships with technology platforms or indirect channels.
* Experience within ecommerce, logistics or last-mile delivery, with a solid understanding of how merchants integrate carriers into fulfilment and returns operations.
* Experience developing and executing partner enablement programmes or channel go-to-market activity that drives indirect revenue.
* Experience in commercial negotiation and agreement management with technology or platform partners.
* Strong relationship-building skills across commercial, technical and product stakeholders, and confident, clear communication with varied audiences.
* An organised, self-directed approach to managing multiple partner relationships and workstreams at once.
* Hands-on experience with 3PI / carrier management platforms (e.g. Metapack, Scurri, nShift, Sorted) or returns platforms (e.g. ZigZag, Loop, Narvar).
* Experience managing app marketplace listings or plugin partnerships (Shopify App Store, WooCommerce extensions, Magento Marketplace).
* Familiarity with API-based integrations or technical partner onboarding in a commercial (non-engineering) capacity.
**We’d be particularly excited to hear from you if:**
* Experience contributing to product roadmap decisions as a partner or channel stakeholder.
* Knowledge of the OOH delivery market, locker network operations and the UK last-mile logistics landscape.
**The InPost process:**
We pride ourselves on our candidate experience. We want to make this as straightforward as possible, for you and for us! We will try our best to get back to you within a few days to let you know if we’d like to take you to the first stage. This normally involves a 20 minute chat with our Talent Team. If we both feel the connection, you’ll then go through another one or two stages, depending on the level of the role.
At InPost, we love uniqueness. Our strength is our people.
We strive to create an open, equal, inclusive environment in which everyone has the opportunity to flourish and be themselves.

Overview
IQVIA provides scientific solutions spanning clinical trials, real world evidence, and consulting in all areas of the drug product lifecycle. The Instrument Licensing Solutions and Patient & Site Strategy (ILSPSS) team leads the industry in generating data to ensure that the patient voice is incorporated into the development and commercialization of medication and other drug/non-drug interventions. We focus on understanding and meeting the needs of our clients through the application of broad consulting expertise and technical scientific knowledge to conduct scientifically rigorous research. **About JetBrains**
We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.
**What you’ll do**
Our IDEs are built on a massive scale: a 14 GB monorepo with more than 500 developers committing code every day and hundreds of thousands of automated tests running to keep everything stable. Delivering regular, reliable updates across this ecosystem without blocking engineering teams is a massive infrastructure challenge.
That’s where you come in. You’ll join our infrastructure team as both a technical specialist and process owner for our release infrastructure, building reliable systems that make it possible to ship releases smoothly. You’ll take ownership of the CI/CD pipelines, optimize delivery workflows, and make sure changes flow smoothly from local development all the way to release.That's where you come in. You'll join our infrastructure team as both a technical specialist and process owner for our release infrastructure, building reliable systems that make it possible to ship releases smoothly. You'll take ownership of the CI/CD pipelines, optimize delivery workflows, and work closely with engineering teams to keep changes moving smoothly from local development through to release.
Day to day, you will:
* Design, configure, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to keep releases reliable and repeatable.
* Manage branching strategies, coordinate code freezes, and handle hotfix releases.
* Diagnose pipeline failures and resolve build bottlenecks before they affect delivery.
* Automate repetitive release tasks and improve YouTrack workflows for better issue tracking.
* Gather requirements from development teams to turn pain points into smooth tooling improvements.
* Communicate process changes to stakeholders and support teams through transitions.
* Lead retrospectives after incidents to continuously refine our release process.
**What you’ll bring**
* Curiosity and a systematic approach to solving complex infrastructure problems.
* Clear communication skills to collaborate with multiple engineering teams.
* A strong drive to automate manual tasks and remove friction for fellow developers.

# Senior Security Engineer
### About Kestra
Kestra is the **universal orchestration platform**: open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems.
Trusted by **over 10,000 organizations worldwide**, including **JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole**, Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to **30,000 GitHub stars**, hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community.
### About the role
Kestra runs arbitrary, user-defined code at scale. Our users write workflows that execute scripts, containers, and queries against their own production systems, through hundreds of community-built plugins, on a platform whose entire source code is public. That is an unusually rich attack surface, and securing it is a genuinely hard engineering problem rather than a checklist exercise. **You would be our first dedicated security hire.** We're looking for a **Senior Security Engineer** to own and elevate the end-to-end security posture of our platform, infrastructure, and open-source ecosystem. This is a unique, hybrid role for someone who excels at both sides of security: actively breaking systems to find vulnerabilities (hands-on penetration testing) and actively fixing them (opening PRs, patching infrastructure, and managing supply chain risks). If you want to build a world-class security foundation for a fast-growing open-source and SaaS platform, this role is for you. **This is a hands-on engineering role, not a GRC or compliance one.**
### What you would do
Your first six months would focus on the first three points below. The rest is where the role grows.
* **Conduct hands-on penetration testing** and threat modeling across our web application, APIs, control plane, and cloud environments.
* **Manage end-to-end vulnerability tracking** across our codebases, software dependencies (SCA), container images, and cloud infrastructure.
* **Proactively fix security flaws** by writing patches, submitting Pull Requests (PRs), or collaborating directly with product teams to guide remediation.
* **Audit and harden our cloud infrastructure** (GCP, Kubernetes clusters, and networking configurations) against external and internal threats.
* **Automate security tooling** into our CI/CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, dependency scanners) to catch CVEs before code reaches production.
* **Perform security code reviews** and evaluate third-party dependencies, open-source integrations, and supply-chain risks.
* **Lead incident response** efforts and establish continuous monitoring, detection, and mitigation strategies.
* **Own our public security posture** as an open-source project: vulnerability disclosure process, CVE handling, security advisories, and the trust model of our plugin ecosystem.
### Our Tech Stack
* **Security & Vulnerability Tools**: Trivy, GitHub Security / Dependabot, Elastic Security
* **Infrastructure**: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
* **Cloud**: GCP
* **Programming language**: Java, Typescript, Javascript
* **Datastore**: PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch
* **Queuing**: Redis, Kafka, AMQP
* **Monitoring & Logs**: ELK, Prometheus, Grafana
* **Deployment & Repository**: GitHub Actions, ArgoCD
### What we are looking for
* **5+ years of experience** in Security Engineering, Product Security, DevSecOps, or a combined Offensive/Defensive role.
* **Strong hands-on penetration testing background**, with proven ability to discover application, API, and network-level vulnerabilities.
* **A builder/fixer mindset**: You don't just export scanner PDFs; you can read code, understand exploits, write fixes, or provide clear remediation steps to engineers.
* **Deep familiarity with cloud security** (AWS or GCP) and containerized environments (**Kubernetes**, Docker).
* Experience with **dependency and supply-chain security** (CVE management, open-source licensing, SCA tools).
* Fluent in English and comfortable working autonomously in a fully remote environment.
* Adaptability to a fast-paced open-source startup environment where pragmatism and execution speed matter.
### Perks & Benefits
* **Work from anywhere**: We’re a remote-first company, so you can work from wherever feels like home. Plus, you’ll have access to coworking spaces worldwide if you ever need a change of scenery.
* **Health coverage**: From medical support, dental, and vision, we've got you covered.
* **Home office setup on us**: We’ll provide all the equipment you need to work comfortably.
### Our Hiring Process
We aim to move quickly (2-3 weeks), but we can adjust the timeline if needed.
* **Intro call** with the hiring manager (30 min)
* **Technical scenario / Practical assessment** (2 hours, asynchronous homework focusing on threat assessment and remediation)
* **Team chat** with one of your future colleagues (30 min)

**What is the Great Grid Upgrade?**
The Great Grid Upgrade is the largest overhaul of the UK's electricity transmission network in generations. Led by National Grid, the programme involves upgrading and expanding the high-voltage electricity network across England and Wales to transport increasing amounts of renewable energy, improve energy security and support the UK's transition to a low-carbon future.
The Grimsby to Walpole (GWNC) Enabling Works project is a key part of this programme, supporting the delivery of a new 114km overhead transmission line (OHL) running south from a new 400kV substation and 19-bay AIS substation.
The project will deliver the enabling works required ahead of the main transmission line construction, including ecology mitigation, site clearance and establishment, temporary access roads and crane platforms, temporary bridges, tower foundations (including piling) and reinstatement works. Ground investigations are currently underway, with the enabling works phase running through to the end of 2027 and overall project delivery continuing to approximately 2033.

We're looking for an experienced Construction Manager to lead the safe, efficient and high-quality delivery of construction activities across the GWNC project.
Reporting to the Senior Construction Manager, you will provide leadership across multiple work fronts, ensuring construction activities are delivered safely, on programme, within budget and to the highest standards of quality. You'll lead site teams and specialist subcontractors, coordinate construction operations, drive performance and work closely with engineering, commercial, planning and client teams to achieve successful project outcomes.

* SAP PLM experience (essential or highly desirable).

* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong organisational and administrative skills.

* Effective stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Problem-solving and analytical thinking.

job_title: Senior AI Product Engineer (React / Typescript) - UX
job_description:
Landytech is on a mission to revolutionise the way that investment managers, asset owners and their advisors access asset information. Powered by Sesame, an industry-leading investment reporting platform, we are helping clients in over 15 countries make informed investment decisions and deliver insights faster.
The company is growing rapidly and it’s an exciting time to join, having secured $12M in Series B funding in January 2023. In just four years, it has gone from two co-founders to a team of 80+ staff, with offices in London and Paris. At Landytech, we see diversity as our strength with a team from over 15 countries and 14 languages spoken.
The role
AI has made producing screens easy. It has not made products coherent. We are looking for someone to own the experience of Sesame end to end — the client journey, the interaction logic, the look and feel, and the consistency of all of it — and to build it.
If you are an engineer who has always had a view on how the product should look and behave, this is a role where that judgement is part of the remit rather than a side interest.
We have posted this role under two titles — Design Engineer and Product Experience Designer — to reach both backgrounds. Same role, same team. Apply once, to whichever fits you better.
How we work
We have rebuilt our product process around AI rather than bolting it on:
• AI is used heavily at every stage of both design and engineering, not just at the production end
• Our design system lives in code, used by engineers and AI tooling alike
• Tooling changes every few months and we expect it to
You will have real scope to shape how we work, and to help build the parts that do not exist yet.
What you will shape
How much of this you lead outright will depend on your experience and on how it fits with the team already in place. There is room to take on more over time.
The front-end experience layer. You will build the interfaces that matter most, particularly the dense and difficult ones, and help set the patterns others follow
The design system. Developed in code with the rest of the front-end team, with a leading voice in what belongs in the system
Look, feel and consistency. The product should feel like one thing, and you will help define what that one thing is and uphold it in review and in tooling
The client journey. You will be in front of investment professionals, family offices and their advisors, and trusted to act on what you hear
Craft in dense financial interfaces. Tables legible at scale, numbers at the right precision, drill-downs that survive a messy real portfolio under load
The must-have: setting the standard AI works to
AI is very good at producing attractive interfaces. Given a design system, almost anyone can now generate a credible screen.
The harder problem, and the one this role exists to solve, is making sure what we build expresses the product’s logic, density and intent rather than simply reusing its components. That means defining the standards and instructions our tools work to, reading the output critically enough to see why something is subtly wrong, and tightening the rules so it does not recur.
Using AI to produce interfaces is not the skill we are looking for. Directing it to our standard, consistently and at depth, is.
Increasingly this is engineering work: it lives in the repo, in the tooling, and in what the agents can and cannot reach for.
Strongly valued: design expertise
We are not looking for a front-end engineer willing to tolerate design work. We are looking for real UX judgement.
You can say what is wrong with a flow, not just implement it faster
You think in objects, relationships and states before components
You have taste in what matters here: hierarchy, typography, density, restraint
You are comfortable doing the upstream thinking, including what should not exist at all
No portfolio required. Shipped interfaces we can look at, and the decisions behind them, is what we want to see.
Also valued: product management instincts
If you have talked to clients directly, decided what not to build, and owned an outcome rather than a ticket, we will weight it heavily.
What we are looking for
We do not expect anyone to have everything below — we would rather meet someone exceptional in two areas than adequate in all three.
5+ years in front-end engineering, ideally React and TypeScript, with libraries such as shadcn/ui
Experience building and maintaining a design system in production, not just consuming one
Data-dense interfaces at scale — virtualised tables, charting, performance under real load
Fluency with AI-assisted development, and the specification skill described above
Willingness to work directly with users and own the experience, not the implementation alone
Comfortable as an editor and enabler: reviewing others’ work, teaching, holding a line

Landytech is on a mission to revolutionise the way that investment managers, asset owners and their advisors access asset information. Powered by Sesame, an industry-leading investment reporting platform, we are helping clients in over 15 countries make informed investment decisions and deliver insights faster.
The company is growing rapidly and it’s an exciting time to join, having secured $12M in Series B funding in January 2023. In just four years, it has gone from two co-founders to a team of 80+ staff, with offices in London and Paris. At Landytech, we see diversity as our strength with a team from over 15 countries and 14 languages spoken.
The role
AI has made producing screens easy. It has not made products coherent. We are looking for someone to own the experience of Sesame end to end — the client journey, the interaction logic, the look and feel, and the consistency of all of it — and to build it.
If you are an engineer who has always had a view on how the product should look and behave, this is a role where that judgement is part of the remit rather than a side interest.
We have posted this role under two titles — Design Engineer and Product Experience Designer — to reach both backgrounds. Same role, same team. Apply once, to whichever fits you better.
How we work
We have rebuilt our product process around AI rather than bolting it on:
• AI is used heavily at every stage of both design and engineering, not just at the production end
• Our design system lives in code, used by engineers and AI tooling alike
• Tooling changes every few months and we expect it to
You will have real scope to shape how we work, and to help build the parts that do not exist yet.
What you will shape
How much of this you lead outright will depend on your experience and on how it fits with the team already in place. There is room to take on more over time.
The front-end experience layer. You will build the interfaces that matter most, particularly the dense and difficult ones, and help set the patterns others follow
The design system. Developed in code with the rest of the front-end team, with a leading voice in what belongs in the system
Look, feel and consistency. The product should feel like one thing, and you will help define what that one thing is and uphold it in review and in tooling
The client journey. You will be in front of investment professionals, family offices and their advisors, and trusted to act on what you hear
Craft in dense financial interfaces. Tables legible at scale, numbers at the right precision, drill-downs that survive a messy real portfolio under load
The must-have: setting the standard AI works to
AI is very good at producing attractive interfaces. Given a design system, almost anyone can now generate a credible screen.
The harder problem, and the one this role exists to solve, is making sure what we build expresses the product’s logic, density and intent rather than simply reusing its components. That means defining the standards and instructions our tools work to, reading the output critically enough to see why something is subtly wrong, and tightening the rules so it does not recur.
Using AI to produce interfaces is not the skill we are looking for. Directing it to our standard, consistently and at depth, is.
Increasingly this is engineering work: it lives in the repo, in the tooling, and in what the agents can and cannot reach for.
Strongly valued: design expertise
We are not looking for a front-end engineer willing to tolerate design work. We are looking for real UX judgement.
You can say what is wrong with a flow, not just implement it faster
You think in objects, relationships and states before components
You have taste in what matters here: hierarchy, typography, density, restraint
You are comfortable doing the upstream thinking, including what should not exist at all
No portfolio required. Shipped interfaces we can look at, and the decisions behind them, is what we want to see.
Also valued: product management instincts
If you have talked to clients directly, decided what not to build, and owned an outcome rather than a ticket, we will weight it heavily.
What we are looking for
We do not expect anyone to have everything below — we would rather meet someone exceptional in two areas than adequate in all three.
5+ years in front-end engineering, ideally React and TypeScript, with libraries such as shadcn/ui
Experience building and maintaining a design system in production, not just consuming one
Data-dense interfaces at scale — virtualised tables, charting, performance under real load
Fluency with AI-assisted development, and the specification skill described above
Willingness to work directly with users and own the experience, not the implementation alone
Comfortable as an editor and enabler: reviewing others’ work, teaching, holding a line
Genuine curiosity about finance. You need not arrive knowing what a capital call is
Our process
Our interview process is likely to include a portfolio or work conversation, a short practical exercise based on a real Sesame flow, and a working session with a product manager and an engineer. We adapt the steps to the candidate and will always tell you what to expect in advance.

You'll sit within the Legal Engineering team and work hand in hand with Product at one of the fastest-growing legal AI companies in the world, seeing new capabilities before almost anyone else, experimenting with them against real legal work, and turning what you learn into the standards a global function runs on. This is a judgement role, not a filing one. You'll be the person who vets the skills, workflows and use cases the function ships: testing them hands-on, separating the genuinely strong from the merely plausible, and quality-controlling practice-area workflows so that what carries the Legora name is consistently excellent. You'll research and experiment with prompting techniques and applied AI methods, author the exemplar use cases the rest of the function copies, and teach what you learn: delivering technical onboarding for new Legal Engineers in your region and broadcasting best practices to the team worldwide. * Vet the Skills Library and Legal Engineering outputs against the quality bar: review skills, workflows and use cases hands-on before they go live, and quality-control practice-area workflows for consistency.
* Research and experiment with prompting techniques, skill patterns and emerging AI methods, and turn what works into best practices the whole function adopts.
* Author the reference use cases that show what great looks like, published as the exemplars others copy.

This role is built to grow with the field itself. # Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Computer Vision
AI Engineer
#### About the Role
As a Senior Computer Vision Engineer, you will lead the end to end development of an enterprise workplace safety and compliance detection pipeline. You will design, train, calibrate and deploy production computer vision models that turn raw client camera footage into operational insight that a reviewer can act on and a client can trust.
The work spans detection and multi-object tracking, region derivation from pose landmarks, instance segmentation for measurement, and temporal and zone aware rules. It also spans the parts that decide whether a model survives contact with a real site: honest evaluation against a contractual target, generalisation across camera viewpoints and locations, compute cost, and a lifecycle that keeps the model accurate after launch.
This role bridges hands on ML engineering with client facing leadership. You will architect pipelines that move from cloud batch execution to edge inference as a configuration change, work directly with global enterprise stakeholders, and transfer capability to client nominated technical staff.
#### What you'll do
* **Build the core detection pipeline**. Design and build detection on client camera footage: person and object detection, multi-object tracking, region derivation from pose landmarks, and classifiers that include an explicit "cannot determine" outcome rather than guessing.
* **Extend beyond frame level detection**. Take the pipeline into instance segmentation for area measurement, temporal reasoning for duration based rules, and zone aware logic where detection rules differ by location.
* **Own the ground truth**. Lead construction of a labelled dataset from raw footage, including labelling guidelines, adjudication process, class imbalance handling, split hygiene for video, and hard case mining.
* **Train, calibrate and prove performance**. Train, fine tune and calibrate models against contractual performance targets. Own the held out evaluation methodology end to end: sample selection, adjudication, and honest reporting of TP, FP, TN, FN, error rates and the confidence interval around them.
* **Produce outputs reviewers can work with**. Derive person level and event level outputs with duration, feeding operational dashboards and alerting where reviewers inspect the underlying frames.
* **Design for generalisation**. Build so the system holds up across camera viewpoints and sites, and so that adding a camera or a location is a bounded exercise rather than a new project.
* **Make deployment location a configuration choice**. Architect so inference location is a configuration change: cloud batch now, edge inference as camera counts scale.
* **Engineer for compute cost**. Consumption is a live client concern. Own frame sampling strategy, motion and zone gating, the CPU and GPU split, and batch against streaming trade offs.
* **Own the model lifecycle**. Versioning, drift detection, and a retraining loop fed by human reviewer decisions.
* **Advise on capture quality**. Write camera placement, positioning and image quality recommendations for the client's facilities team.
* **Transfer the capability**. Deliver recorded enablement sessions and work alongside client nominated technical staff so the client can run and extend what you build.
#### What we're looking for
* **Experience**. 5+ years in applied machine learning, with at least 3 years of computer vision shipped to production and operating on real world footage rather than curated datasets.
* **Detection and tracking, hands on**. Deep experience with object detection and multi-object tracking. You have trained, fine tuned and debugged these, not only run pretrained weights. Familiarity across detector families including YOLO, two stage detectors such as Faster R-CNN, and transformer based detectors such as RT-DETR or RF-DETR, with tracking experience such as SORT or DeepSORT.
* **Segmentation and measurement**. Instance segmentation experience, and the ability to convert pixel measurements into real world units through camera calibration.
* **Pose and keypoints**. Human pose estimation or keypoint based region localisation.
* **Dataset construction**. Demonstrated experience building labelled datasets from raw footage, including labelling strategy, handling severe class imbalance, and avoiding leakage in video splits.
* **Evaluation fundamentals**. Precision and recall trade offs, operating point selection, probability calibration, and the judgement to say clearly what has not been measured, including to non technical stakeholders.
* **Domain shift**. Practical understanding of domain shift. You have dealt with a model that worked on one camera and failed on another, and you know what to do about it.
* **Distributed processing**. Working knowledge of distributed processing. Your pipelines will run on Databricks and Spark. The platform team owns the environment, but you need to be effective in it rather than blocked by it.
* **Core tooling.** Proficient in Python and PyTorch or equivalent.
* **Licensing awareness**. Awareness of open source licensing implications for commercially delivered models, including copyleft terms attached to common vision frameworks.
* **Data governance**. Comfortable working under data governance constraints: client tenant only, no local copies of footage, imagery of identifiable individuals treated accordingly.
* **Communication**. Strong written and spoken English, and the confidence to present methodology and defend results directly to client stakeholders.
#### Nice to have
* PPE detection, workplace safety, or video surveillance analytics.
* Temporal action recognition or behaviour classification over video, as distinct from single frame classification.
* Multimodal work combining vision with sensor or time series data.
* Fine grained discrimination between visually similar classes.
* Edge inference deployment, for example NVIDIA Jetson or similar.
* Databricks ML tooling: MLflow and Unity Catalog governed data.
* Systems designed around a human in the loop review step.
* Animal or livestock monitoring.
* Prior consulting or client facing delivery experience.
#### Location
Fully remote. Must have availability to work overlapping U.S. Pacific, Central, or Eastern time zones.
#### Application Deadline
Applications will be accepted until **October 4th, 2026**. Candidates can expect feedback by **October 12th, 2026**.
## Salary
**Salary range:** $80k - $120k annually, with final compensation determined by your qualifications, expertise, experience, and the role's scope.
## Benefits
In addition to competitive pay, we offer a variety of benefits to support your professional and personal growth, including:
* Flexible working hours in a remote environment.
* Health insurance (medical and dental) for W2 Employees.
* 401K Contribution.
* A professional development fund to enhance your skills and knowledge.
* 15 days of paid time off annually.
* Access to soft-skill development courses to further your career.
## Position Details
This is a full-time position requiring a minimum of **40 hours per week, Monday through Friday**.

OverviewApplication
NetBox Labs seeks a **Staff Software Backend Engineer** to technically lead our Foundations team. Foundations is the platform team that builds shared platform primitives that other engineering teams depend on including core services for authentication, access control, customer secrets management, and customer telemetry. This role will own the technical direction for Foundations. You will partner with the Foundations Engineering Manager, who owns people and process, while you own architecture and technical execution.
### **Responsibilities:**
* Own the architecture of the Platform Authorization Service (PAS), the system that controls access across the platform.
* Set the technical direction for identity, single sign-on (SSO), access control, secrets management services and more.
* Lead delivery of Foundations core services, including login, authorization, and tenancy.
* Act as the primary technical decision maker for Foundations.
* Lead and mentor the Foundations engineering team through daily technical work.
* Partner with the Foundations Engineering Manager and Product Manager on team execution.
* Drive core components through to GA (general availability) launch.
* Define API contracts for platform services that others consume, including Delivery Platform and Application teams.
* Work with the Foundations Product Manager to align technical plans with product priorities.
* Set engineering standards for code review, testing, and documentation across the team.
### **Requirements:**
* 7+ years of software development experience, including technical ownership of a platform or infrastructure area.
* 3+ years of experience in a B2B software startup or high-growth organization.
* Direct experience with authentication and authorization systems (for example, OAuth, SSO, or role-based access control).
* Experience leading engineering work without formal manager authority.
* Backend programming experience in Python and Go.
* Experience designing APIs consumed by other engineering teams.
* Strong Linux and distributed systems fundamentals.
* A track record of making technical decisions under ambiguity.
### **Nice to Have:**
* Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.
* Experience with network management or infrastructure software (for example, NetBox).
* Open-source contributions or project involvement.
* Comfort with AI-enhanced tooling (for example, Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor).
Join NetBox Labs. Help build the identity and access foundation the rest of the platform relies on.
## About NetBox Labs:
NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.
NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.
NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

* We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.
* Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.
* We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity
* Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

Newmark’s graduate planning programme is the perfect way to kickstart your career in town planning and development consultancy. You’ll gain hands-on experience across live planning projects, work with senior chartered town planners, and develop the skills and competencies needed to achieve your Chartered Town Planner (MRTPI) status through the Royal Town Planning Institute's accredited routes. • Conducting site visits and appraisals, and supporting pre-application and due diligence advice on development sites • Assisting with the preparation and submission of planning applications, representations, and supporting planning statements • Researching and analysing national, regional, and local planning policy to support advice on development proposals • Drafting sections of planning statements, appraisals, and client reports for senior review • Liaising with clients, local planning authorities, architects, and other professionals as part of multidisciplinary project teams • Maintaining accurate records and project data to support the wider Planning and Development team's pipeline • Working towards RTPI chartership requirements - logging structured training and experience, and meeting regularly with a designated mentor • Gradually taking on more client-facing responsibility as competency and confidence build across projects

• Ambition and drive to excel, with a clear commitment to working towards Chartered Town Planner (MRTPI) status • Strong analytical and research skills, comfortable working with planning policy, data, and development appraisals • Excellent written and verbal communication • Commercial curiosity - an interest in London's planning environment and development landscape, and how policy and politics shape decision-making • Initiative and accountability - the confidence to take ownership of tasks while knowing when to ask for guidance Application Process
• Submit an online application including CV and answer a few short screening questions • MS Teams interview with one interviewer • In Person Interview with two assessors

# Senior CRM Strategist Planner – Client Success Team
## We're looking for an experienced CRM strategist to join Plinc's Client Success team in a senior, strategic role, offered on a part-time basis.
**Role overview**
We're looking for an experienced CRM strategist to join Plinc's Client Success team in a senior, strategic role, offered on a part-time basis. You'll be the critical link between customer understanding and creative marketing execution, turning data and insight into CRM strategy.
Since 2001, Plinc has been helping big consumer brands boost their relevance, resonance and revenue. We’ve got a unique approach to connecting, analysing, and harnessing data that helps turn casual customers into consistent buyers.
We are a group of solutions-focused data experts passionate about helping our clients achieve amazing things, whether it’s through expertly engineered data platforms or innovative analytics and strategic planning. We work with some of the world’s biggest and most respected brands and are at an exciting time in our evolution, with ambitious plans to scale our solutions and reach an even broader audience.
**Why join Plinc**
* The chance to help build and shape Plinc's strategic function, not just deliver within an existing one.
* Working with Unilyze, our AI-optimised, real-time customer data platform, connecting millions of customers and billions of interactions.
* The scale and backing of the wider Savanta & Next 15 group, including mentoring, coaching and training programmes.
If you are looking for a role in a nurturing, fun, people-focused environment and welcome the chance to test your skills working with super-ambitious brands, then this is the opportunity for you. We invest in our people and promote personal development, offering training and support for growth and a range of employee benefits.
**What you'll bring**
* Demonstrable experience delivering CRM and customer strategy for clients, from customer journeys and lifecycle strategy to segmentation, targeting and contact strategy.
* Strong data planning and analytical skills, comfortable collaborating with analysts and data scientists to turn data into actionable strategy.
* A solid understanding of measurement, experimentation and test-and-learn approaches.
* A proactive, curious mindset, with a track record of spotting client challenges and opportunities beyond the original brief.
* Strong visual storytelling skills and the confidence to present to and build trusted relationships with senior clients, including constructively challenging established thinking.
* Experience contributing strategic thinking to pitches and new business.
* A collaborative team player, comfortable working across multiple accounts and stakeholder levels at once.
**Key responsibilities**
* Proactively identify client challenges and unmet needs, turning them into new briefing opportunities.
* Partner with our analytics, technical and client teams to turn customer, behavioural and performance data into clear, actionable strategy.
* Develop CRM and customer engagement strategies, customer journeys, lifecycle and contact strategies, and communications frameworks, and support their execution.
* Build targeting strategies and measurement frameworks that improve CRM effectiveness and inform optimisation.
* Present recommendations confidently to senior client audiences through clear, compelling visual outputs.
* Contribute to pitches and new business, helping shape the CRM strategy and strategic story, and run or contribute to client growth initiatives such as business reviews, audits and ideation workshops.
* Help build and shape Plinc's strategic function, championing strategic thinking across teams, a genuine opportunity to leave your mark as the function grows.
**About You**
We're looking for someone highly organised and detail-focused, who brings positive leadership qualities, strong interpersonal skills and a natural collaborative approach. You'll be customer-centric in your thinking, motivated by delivering real impact for clients, and able to build trusted relationships through thoughtful planning and a proactive attitude.
**Useful skills**
* A minimum of 5 years' working in a CRM strategy role, or demonstrable expertise in this area.
* Experience/familiarity with
1. Marketing technology and automation platforms (SCV, CDP),
2. Web analytics/personalisation tools,
3. BI tools.
**Working hours and office expectations**
This is a part-time role offered at 3 days a week, with the potential to rise to 4 as business needs evolve. We're open to how those days (or equivalent hours) are structured (three full days, four partial days, or another pattern) provided the arrangement is consistent but we do ask for flexibility around key client meetings that fall outside the agreed pattern.
We operate a hybrid working environment and we expect attendance to be around 2–4 times a month, prioritising days with a team or company meeting or event (typically Thursdays).
**And in return, Plinc offers\***
* Salary Range: £65,000-£75,000 (FTE)
* Bonus scheme
* 25 days paid annual leave (FTE), buy/sell scheme + additional days for long service
* Hybrid working
* Flexible working practices
* Ongoing Training & Development
* Health & Wellbeing package
* Financial Health (pension, life assurance, etc.)
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Team & Company Socials
* and many more
\*Full details of local benefits and perks available on request from the People Team (HR).

**Department:** Finance **Reports to:** Head of Credit **Location:** NMBS Head Office / hybrid working as agreed **Document purpose:** This role profile sets out the core purpose, responsibilities, performance standards and personal attributes required for the Senior Credit Risk Analyst role in 2026.
## Role purpose
The Senior Credit Risk Analyst supports disciplined credit risk management across the NMBS member base, with a particular focus on higher-value credit exposures, financial statement review, credit-limit recommendations and management information. The role provides analytical insight to the Head of Credit and wider Finance team, helping NMBS make informed, timely and commercially balanced credit decisions.
In a challenging trading environment, the role is expected to strengthen NMBS’s credit control capability by enhancing the quality of risk analysis, supporting member engagement, enhancing reporting and helping the Credit Risk team work in a more efficient, consistent and proactive way.
## Key responsibilities
### Credit risk analysis and credit-limit management
* Perform detailed credit risk analysis on members to support the credit decision-making process.
* Review annual financial statements, management accounts and other financial information received from members.
* Identify financial stress indicators, trading concerns, liquidity pressures and other emerging risk signals.
* Assess member creditworthiness and provide clear recommendations to the Head of Credit on appropriate credit-limit setting.
* Take ownership of a defined portfolio of higher-value member credit limits and manage these proactively from a credit risk perspective.
* Support the Head of Credit with annual member credit reviews and ad hoc risk assessments.
* Engage with members’ finance and commercial teams where required, to obtain information, understand trading context and support effective credit review.
* Attend member meetings where appropriate to discuss financial statements, credit position and risk-related matters.
### Reporting, management information and insight
* Produce clear, accurate and timely reports relating to the management of the back-office credit risk process.
* Prepare a monthly credit risk report for the Head of Credit, highlighting key exposures, movements, risks, actions and recommendations.
* Track agreed KPIs and provide evidence-based commentary on progress, exceptions and areas requiring attention.
* Improve the quality and consistency of credit risk reporting so that outputs are useful, actionable and suitable for senior review.
* Use data and analysis to identify trends, recurring issues and opportunities for process improvement.
### Team support and process improvement
* Support Credit Risk team members by sharing knowledge, best practice and practical guidance.
* Help develop smarter, more efficient and consistent ways of working within the Credit Risk team.
* Contribute to process improvement across credit checking, member review, credit-limit monitoring and reporting.
* Bring forward ideas and initiatives that improve control, accuracy, productivity or member service.
* Assist in all areas of credit management as required, particularly during periods of increased workload or business pressure.
### Member, supplier and internal stakeholder engagement
* Maintain a professional, customer-focused approach when dealing with members, suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* Communicate clearly and confidently by telephone, email and in meetings.
* Build strong working relationships across Finance, Credit Risk and the wider NMBS business.
* Escalate concerns promptly and constructively, ensuring that risks are visible and understood.
* Represent the Credit Risk function professionally when engaging with members and external contacts.
### General responsibilities
* Work in line with NMBS policies, procedures and standards.
* Maintain confidentiality when handling member financial information and commercially sensitive data.
* Support the wider Finance team and Head of Credit with additional duties that are appropriate to the role and business needs.
## Performance standards
The role holder will be expected to demonstrate the following standards:
* Strong experience in credit control, credit risk management or a closely related finance discipline.
* Ability to interpret financial statements, management accounts and supporting financial information.
* Sound judgement in identifying financial stress signals and assessing the level of risk presented.
* Ability to work under pressure, prioritise effectively and meet required deadlines.
* Delivery of agreed objectives and KPIs, both individually and as part of the wider team.
* High standards of accuracy, attention to detail and consistency in analysis and reporting.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of tasks and make well-reasoned recommendations.
* Professional communication style, including an excellent telephone manner and clear written communication.
* Willingness to travel within the UK where required for member meetings.
* Flexibility to support the business outside standard working hours where this is reasonably required.
* Openness to change, continuous improvement and constructive feedback.
## Personal attributes
The role holder should demonstrate:
* Strong analytical thinking and a structured approach to problem solving.
* Self-motivation and the ability to work proactively on their own initiative.
* A collaborative approach and willingness to support colleagues within a close-knit team.
* Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Confidence in building relationships with members, suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* A practical, commercially aware approach to credit risk assessment.
* Professional resilience and the ability to remain calm under pressure.
* A positive attitude, with a drive to deliver high-quality work and continuous improvement.
* Commitment to personal development and keeping knowledge current.
* Advanced Excel skills and confidence working with financial data.

Nucleus Financial Platforms runs its data estate on Microsoft Fabric. The Data Engineering team ingests data from the group's platform systems and enterprise tools, transforms it through a four layer architecture, and delivers it as a curated data warehouse and semantic model layer. That output supports management information, financial reporting, self service analytics, an emerging AI capability, and regulatory returns under FCA and PRA obligations. 
As a Data Engineer you will build and maintain the pipelines, warehouse objects and reporting models that make that happen. You will work within an established architecture and a documented set of design standards, taking individual pipelines and warehouse objects from development through peer review and into production. The platform holds client and financial data in a regulated environment, so accuracy, repeatability and a clear audit trail matter as much as delivery speed. 
How we work 
We work in an Agile cycle alongside a Product Owner. Everything we build is version controlled in Azure DevOps and promoted through Fabric deployment pipelines across development, test and live. Development takes place in an isolated feature workspace, every change is peer reviewed before it reaches production, and anything touching regulatory reporting carries an additional test and approval gate. A daily rota covers platform health checks each morning, and documentation is treated as part of the build rather than an afterthought. 
Responsibilities: 
* Build and maintain data pipelines: Develop Fabric Data Pipelines and Notebooks that collect data from platform and enterprise source systems over SFTP, API and gateway database connections, land it in the Fabric Lakehouse, and load it into the persistent staging layer of the Fabric Data Warehouse.
* Develop warehouse logic: Write and optimise the SQL stored procedures that transform staged data into the curated dimensional model, applying the team's standard dimension and fact load patterns.
* Build the consumption layer: Develop Fabric semantic models and DAX measures, Power BI reports and paginated reports that give the business governed, self service access to the warehouse.
* Work to the platform design standards: Apply the documented architecture, naming conventions and re-runnability rules to everything you build, so that any step can be safely re-run from the point of failure without producing duplicate or inconsistent data.
* Test and validate your own work: Run affected pipelines end to end in an isolated feature workspace, and check row counts, key values, logging and downstream impact against expected results before raising a pull request.
* Review your colleagues' work: Carry out peer review on pull requests in Azure DevOps, checking correctness, adherence to standards, and the impact of a change on shared objects and downstream reports.
* Support daily platform operations: Take your turn on the ETL rota, confirming overnight runs have completed, investigating failures, and applying the documented recovery procedures within the team's resolution targets.
* Work within change control: Use feature branches and feature workspaces for every change, and meet the additional approval gates that apply to regulatory pipelines and semantic models.
* Document what you build: Produce and maintain per pipeline documentation covering transformation logic, data mappings and known edge cases, so that any engineer in the team can operate and recover your pipelines.
* Work with the business: Collaborate with colleagues across finance, operations, risk and the platform businesses to understand what they need from the data, and help them interpret what they are given.
* Take part in Agile ceremonies: Contribute to planning, backlog refinement and retrospectives, and keep the team sighted on progress and blockers.
Key Skills: 
* SQL development: Strong SQL skills, including writing and optimising stored procedures against a relational warehouse such as SQL Server, Azure SQL or Fabric.
* ETL and pipeline development: Practical experience building, troubleshooting and maintaining ETL processes and data pipelines in a cloud data platform such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Synapse or Databricks.
* Dimensional modelling: A solid grounding in data warehousing concepts, including star schemas, fact grain, surrogate keys and slowly changing dimensions.
* Semantic models and reporting: Experience building semantic models, writing DAX measures, and developing Power BI reports or dashboards.
* Python and scripting: Working knowledge of Python for file parsing and automation, ideally within notebooks. PowerShell or C# are useful additions.
* Source control and peer review: Comfortable with Git branching, pull requests and code review, ideally in Azure DevOps.
* Quality and testing: A methodical approach to validating your own work and that of your peers, including reconciling back to source and checking downstream impact.
* Analytical and problem solving skills: The ability to trace a data issue back through the layers to its cause rather than patching the symptom.
* Communication: Able to explain technical detail to non technical colleagues, and to ask the right questions when a requirement is not fully formed.
Desirable Experience: 
* Microsoft Fabric: Hands on experience with the Fabric Lakehouse, Fabric Data Warehouse, Data Pipelines, Notebooks and deployment pipelines. A certification such as DP-700 is welcome but not required.
* Regulated environment: Experience working under formal change control, where evidence and auditability are attached to what you deliver.
* Financial services domain: Exposure to platform, wrap, pensions or investment data, including holdings, transactions, flows and charges.
* Data quality and reconciliation: Experience operating or designing reconciliation and validation controls between a source system and a warehouse.

We’re hiring because the work is arriving faster than we can deliver it. In the last year we’ve gone from purely bespoke builds to a repeatable audit-and-transformation model, and the pipeline keeps growing.
You’d be our first senior delivery hire. That means clients of your own and a real say in how we price, hire and run the company, with equity that grows as we do. The work covers a genuine range, a regulated fintech one month and a heritage retail brand the next, so the problems don’t repeat.
We tell clients when AI won’t help them, and it’s a large part of why they keep us. Your first months are spent learning our method alongside the founders on live engagements, then you take on clients of your own. If we keep growing the way the pipeline suggests, this becomes the role the next delivery hires report to.
## The role
This is a people-facing engineering role. Most clients don’t know where AI can actually help them, so engagements start with an AI audit: interviews and workshops with leadership and each department, to understand how the business makes its money and where the time actually goes. The client leaves with a roadmap and their first tools already running, and after that we embed with their team and deliver the rest. You’d own the whole engagement. In practice:
* You sit inside a business, talking to everyone from leadership to the teams doing the work, and find the bottlenecks AI can reliably clear.
* You work out which tasks AI can genuinely help with, and you say so plainly when it can’t.
* You turn that into a plan: what to change first, what to leave alone.
* You build it, wiring data sources, AI platforms, integrations and configuration into their live systems and getting something working quickly.
* You agree up front what success looks like, whether that’s hours saved or the worst of the grind gone, then show you hit it.
* You train the people who’ll use it until it sticks, so they’re still using it after you’ve moved on.
* You find the next workflow worth doing and keep supporting the client.
## The stack
You work across whatever the client already runs: usually one of the major clouds (AWS, Azure or GCP) and the main model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or open-weight models where data has to stay on premises), wired into their existing systems through APIs, MCP servers and connectors. Email jobs@openkit.co.uk with your CV and a short cover note, three paragraphs at most, on why you’re a good fit. Include one thing you’ve built that you’re proud of, with a couple of lines on what it is and what you actually did on it. Use the subject line “FDE application” followed by your name.

* Supporting the Facilities team with client reporting

* Understanding of PPM and reactive maintenance

You'll play an important role in keeping our maintenance operation running smoothly.

The Quality & Delivery Specialist is an active, hands-on **Software Engineer** role that combines core web development execution with dedicated delivery coordination. While primarily an engineering role writing code and addressing backlog requirements, this position carries a specialist focus: directly assisting the Engineering Manager in driving flow, managing Jira Kanban boards, and maintaining strict release health and quality standards across web and mobile products. You will build new features, fix bugs, and reduce technical debt while serving as the primary engineering catalyst to eliminate delivery bottlenecks, ensure pre-production operational quality, and orchestrate smooth production releases.
## Key Responsibilities
## Core Engineering Responsibilities
* **Active Codebase Contribution:** Actively write clean, secure, and performant code in PHP and/or Python to deliver work from the backlog, including feature development, bug fixes, and critical technical debt.
* **Full-Lifecycle Ownership:** Drive engineering tasks through the complete lifecycle - from architecture and coding through code review, containerised testing, production deployment, and post-release monitoring.
* **Engineering Standards & Code Review:** Enforce version control (Git) standards and actively participate in peer code reviews, giving and receiving constructive feedback to keep code quality high and technical debt low.
* **Technical Problem Solving:** Apply strong analytical problem-solving skills to isolate complex bugs, refactor legacy code, and resolve technical impediments.
* **Continuous Engineering Improvement:** Advocate for technical process improvements, embrace a "fail-fast" learning mindset, and actively support peers through knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving.
## Board Facilitation & Delivery Flow
* Serve as the engineering anchor on the Jira Kanban board, managing daily board hygiene and ensuring smooth flow from initial backlog prioritisation through development, QA handoff, and deployment.

* Provide immediate visibility into delivery progress, highlighting technical dependencies and unblocking daily impediments during stand-ups to align Product Owners and management.
## Quality Oversight & Operational Testing
* Bridge the gap between active development and quality sign-off by verifying comprehensive test coverage across all engineering tickets prior to release.
* Conduct hands-on operational testing in pre-production environments to validate real-world readiness, edge cases, user flows, and system stability.
* Utilise Docker containerised environments to perform environment checks, release verification, and local test reproductions.
## Release Cadence, Communications & Client Impact
* Manage and execute recurring release cycles (e.g. weekly production deployments) across PHP/Python web platforms while coordinating mobile release branches alongside product teams.
* Design, establish, and maintain a standardised, repeatable release process across web and mobile app products.
* Mitigate client risk by ensuring all deployment scripts, database migrations, and release steps strictly follow established organisational standards.
